- Initial setup: Up to 20 hours during the first week.

- Campaign development: Approximately 20 hours per week.

 and Instagram advertising campaigns you personally managed, including budgets, conversions, sales, and ROAS.

title: Customer Service & Operations Manager – Shopify Fashion Brands (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Service & Operations Manager to oversee the daily customer support and backend operations of our growing Shopify fashion stores.



Our brands are scaling through Google Ads, bringing in more orders, customer inquiries, and operational challenges. We need someone who can take full responsibility for managing our customer service team, handling escalations, coordinating with suppliers, and ensuring everything runs efficiently behind the scenes.



You will work directly with the founders and play an important role in improving our operations as we continue to expand.



We are specifically looking for someone with proven management experience in e-commerce. Previous experience as a customer service agent alone is not sufficient for this position.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow with our business.



Your Responsibilities



Customer Escalations & Problem Solving



You will be responsible for handling complex customer situations, including refund requests, complaints, delivery problems, and potential chargebacks. You understand how to find practical solutions while protecting both customer satisfaction and the business. You will also establish clear guidelines for when support agents should escalate cases to you.



Customer Service Team Management



You will oversee the daily performance of our customer service representatives, ensuring tickets are handled professionally, accurately, and on time. This includes monitoring response times, reviewing ticket quality, training team members, and improving existing SOPs and
 templates. As our stores grow, you will help us expand and structure the team.



Supplier & Order Management



You will communicate directly with our suppliers to resolve issues such as delayed shipments, incorrect products, missing parcels, defective items, and replacement orders. Your responsibility is to ensure these issues are followed up properly and resolved as quickly as possible.



Backend Operations & Process Improvements



You will work closely with the founders to improve how our customer service and backend operations are managed. We expect you to identify recurring issues, suggest improvements, and take initiative rather than waiting for instructions.



Chargeback & Dispute Prevention



An important part of your role is keeping our dispute rates as low as possible. You will proactively resolve customer complaints before they escalate into payment disputes. Previous experience managing chargebacks through Shopify Payments or PayPal is a strong advantage.



Performance Monitoring & Reporting



You will prepare monthly reports for each store, covering customer service performance, refund rates, escalations, response times, and dispute ratios. Beyond reporting numbers, we expect you to identify the main causes of issues and recommend practical solutions.



Tools & Communication



Our team communicates primarily through Slack. We use Google Sheets and Excel for reporting, order management, and supplier coordination.



Experience with customer service platforms such as Re:amaze, Gorgias, or Zendesk is important.



What We're Looking For



- Previous experience as a Customer Service Manager, Operations Manager, Backend Manager, or Team Lead within e-commerce

- Proven experience managing a customer service team and monitoring its performance

- Strong knowledge of Shopify and daily e-commerce operations

- Experience handling difficult customer complaints, refunds, and escalations

- Understanding of chargeback prevention and dispute management

- Experience communicating and resolving issues directly with suppliers

- Familiarity with high-volume e-commerce stores using paid advertising

- Hands-on experience with Re:amaze, Gorgias, or Zendesk

- Strong skills in Slack, Google Sheets, and Excel

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently

- A proactive mindset and flexibility when urgent situations arise



Additional Advantages



- Experience handling disputes through Shopify Payments or PayPal

- Previous experience working with fashion or apparel e-commerce brands

- Experience developing SOPs, training support agents, and improving customer service workflows



What We Offer



- A stable, long-term position within a growing e-commerce business

- The opportunity to take ownership of our customer service and backend operations

- Direct communication and collaboration with the founders

- Room to grow your responsibilities as we launch and scale additional stores

- The freedom to suggest improvements and make a real impact on our daily operations



How to Apply



To confirm that you have read the full job description, please start your application with the word "FASHION".



In your application, briefly explain your most recent management position, how many customer service representatives you managed, and which helpdesk platforms you have experience using.



We are looking for someone who can take responsibility, lead independently, and become a valuable long-term member of our team.

title: AI Operations Lead — Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)
description:
We're a group of four companies, and we're hiring one exceptional person to run operations across all of them with AI tools. You will build and operate the systems that enable each company to run efficiently; you will not replace the functional managers or assume responsibility for their people management.

ARC Group - in-office BPO teams (10+) for mid-sized US companies. No onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

ARC Remote - managed remote staffing for US small businesses.

Kipkeh Media - a WhatsApp media channel for the Orthodox Jewish community.

SetCo / 
 - business entity-formation services.

You report directly to the founder. You'll work closely with our Chief of Staff, she builds the structures, systems, and trusted ground operations; you bring AI-powered execution, optimization, and intelligence. Complementary strengths, not a hierarchy. 

CORE OPERATING PRINCIPLES

Read this carefully: this is a job for a human being who is exceptionally good at using AI tools. Not "uses ChatGPT sometimes." You take entire workflows, lead generation, performance reporting, content planning, billing, invoicing, follow-ups and rebuild them so one person with the right AI stack does what used to take a team. 

However, AI is a means, not the objective.

Impact over tools: We are not automating for automation’s sake. Every system you build must improve revenue, speed, accuracy, cost, visibility, or operational capacity.

Build before you automate: You don’t automate broken processes. First understand the business objective, map the workflow, identify failure points, simplify the process, and then automate what should be automated.

Human judgment: You know when NOT to automate. You understand where human judgment, client relationships, management decisions, and executive judgment must remain human.

AUTHORITY & ESCALATION

You are expected to independently identify problems, recommend solutions, and implement approved operational improvements. You may modify systems and workflows within your area of ownership, but significant changes affecting clients, staffing, pricing, contractual commitments, or company-wide processes require founder approval.

PRIORITIES, IN ORDER

ARC Group pipeline. This is the money. Build the machine that fills it.

ARC Remote running without the founder. Systematize it until he only shows up for relationships and closes.

Kipkeh operations. Money workflow, creator direction, performance intelligence.

NewLLC - automations & processes. Set up the automations and processes alongside the Chief of Staff, so we can hire an admin who handles client relations, billing, filing, and account management and upsells clients into ARC Remote and Kipkeh.

THE MANDATE

Process & SOP Automation - Automate, and continuously improve operational workflows within your assigned areas if necessary. Coordinate with the Chief of Staff and functional owners before materially changing established business processes.

Data & AI Responsibility - You will work with sensitive business, client, employee, and candidate information. You must use approved tools, follow company data-handling rules, and never upload confidential information into an AI platform without authorization.

Marketing - our highest-leverage early win (see below).

Sales support - pipeline tracking, follow-up systems, proposal/invoice workflows. (Closing stays with the founder.)

Recruitment - help hire the roles behind you: screening support, structured interview workflows, candidate tracking.

Management oversight (systems, not people) - build the intelligence layer our managers run on: dashboards, underperformance alerts, KPI tracking, staffing-ratio models. You make problems visible early with data. You do NOT have performance conversations or manage anyone's motivation - when your systems flag a problem, you bring the data to the manager or founder, and they handle the human side.

Systems - design workflows that don't break: edge cases handled, handoffs clean, documented.

Data & reporting - turn raw, messy operational data into decisions. Daily numbers, weekly what's-working analysis, forecasts.

Content operations & direction - direct our on-camera creator with data-backed briefs: what to film, when, and why.

Billing, invoicing, payment tracking - build the money workflow from zero and run it.

Keep up & be ahead - your AI stack is never stale. You bring us tools and methods before we know we need them.

YOUR FIRST BIG WIN: BUILD OUR MARKETING ENGINE

Our Chief of Staff currently runs a small
 lead-gen motion for ARC Group - personally sending 50–100
s, no sequences, no A/B testing. It's time-consuming and going nowhere. The stack is already paid for: Google Workspace + Instantly + Apollo + NeverBounce.

Your job: turn it into a real pipeline machine. Target: 500+
s/week with proper sequences, A/B testing, AI-assisted personalization, tracked follow-ups, and a dashboard the founder can read in 60 seconds. You'll also run the support system behind the founder's LinkedIn outreach, which activates alongside this plan.

Who we're selling to: 50–250 employee companies in three verticals - logistics / freight / supply chain, medical offices (healthcare back-office), and voice agents (customer support / call centers). The offer: in-office BPO teams, no onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

This is how we land our next BPO clients, and it's the single highest-leverage thing you can do in your first 60 days.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

The pipeline machine. List building from the ICP, Instantly sequences, A/B tests, reply triage, follow-up automation, weekly pipeline dashboard. The engine runs; you report the numbers.

ARC Remote, systematized. Map everything the founder does personally; pull it off his plate one workflow at a time. Goal: it runs day-to-day without him.

The money workflow. Advertiser roster, rate sheet, invoices generated from published logs, overdue tracking with follow-up drafts, a Monday money dashboard.

Direct our on-camera creator. He shoots; you think. Turn weekly view data into specific daily shoot briefs backed by numbers, not vibes.

Performance intelligence. Daily view-curve reports from our frame logs. Flag underperforming posts within hours. One-page weekly "what's working" analysis that drives next week's plan.

Management intelligence systems. The dashboards, alerts, and KPI tracking our team leads and account managers run on. You build the visibility; managers handle the people.

Founder's daily digest. One morning briefing: yesterday's numbers, today's plan, decisions needed.

MUST-HAVES

Real, demonstrable AI-tool expertise across: LLMs (advanced prompting, custom assistants/agents), spreadsheet automation (complex formulas, Apps Script or equivalent), data analysis, and workflow automation (Zapier / Make / n8n or similar). We test this live - claims without proof don't pass.

You've built reports or dashboards from raw, messy data before.

Marketing/lead-gen experience:
 outreach, list building, sequencing, follow-up tracking - or a credible plan to build it fast.

You've built or run a billing/invoicing tracker before - or can design one from zero in the interview.

Strong written English. Clear, brief, structured async communication.

Full-time, Philippines-based. This is a 40-hour/week role on a steady, fixed schedule with US-morning (EST) overlap.

No job stacking, no exceptions: this is your only full-time job. No second jobs, freelance clients, or side gigs that compete for your working hours or attention.

Professional setup: 16GB+ RAM, backup internet and power.

NICE-TO-HAVES

Media or content-operations experience.

Experience with remote teams across time zones.

Familiarity with Orthodox Jewish community norms (modesty and kashrus guardrails apply to our channel) - or a fast learner.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: 30 / 60 / 90

Day 14:
 engine live - 500+/week sending on Instantly with sequences and A/B tests. Baseline bounce and unsubscribe rates are actively tracked. First sprint launched on the ICP; LinkedIn support running. ARC Remote audit done: every founder-touch workflow mapped, first one pulled off his plate. The money workflow started. Trial decision point: performing at band level, or we part ways. 

Day 30:
 engine at full volume - 500+/week sending, 2+ A/B tests run with learnings logged. Focus shifts to quality metrics: positive reply rate, qualified replies, meetings booked, and cost/time per qualified opportunity. Reply triage + follow-up system operating with same-day turnaround; pipeline dashboard live. ARC Remote: founder-touch workflows mapped, first SOPs delivered. Creator working from your briefs; first what's-working analysis delivered.

Day 60: The engine runs on rhythm without babysitting. Weekly experiment cadence with results logged. ARC Remote workflows documented and handed over - tracked by the number of workflows automated and measurable hours/cost/error reduction. Underperformer alerts firing same-day. You're the person who spots what's broken across the companies before anyone else does.

Day 90: ARC Group top-of-funnel runs without founder involvement; ARC Remote operates without him; Kipkeh money workflow and creator direction humming. We're scoping your systems across all four companies.

COMPENSATION

$400–600/week, paid weekly via Wise. Full-time, long-term. Exceptional performers grow fast here - including beyond this band. This is a high-impact role with a growth path across four companies.

Trial terms: the first 2 weeks are a paid trial. You come in at a band based on what you demonstrated in the hiring process and in those 2 weeks you have to show it was real. If you're not performing at your band's level, we part ways fast and fairly.

HOW TO APPLY

Record a 2-minute Loom (screen share): show ONE real workflow you automated with AI tools - before, what you built, after. Real example, not a tutorial.

Complete our test task (we send it after your Loom). The test task is paid - $25 USD via Wise. Candidates who advance to the founder interview receive another $25 USD.

No Loom = no review. We move fast for the right person.

Schedule: 20 hrs/week for the first 4 weeks  then 8 hrs/week ongoing support



The project:



We need the person who designs and owns the security and access architecture: who can see what, who approves what, how clients stay completely separated from each other and from the company, and how every action is traceable. You make the design decisions, the team builds with you, and within 4 weeks it goes live in a controlled pilot and is handed over to run without depending on you.



Think of it as building the safe and d
 exactly who can open it, when, and under what conditions.



This role is NOT for you if your experience is mainly maintaining, monitoring, or administering systems someone else designed (sysadmin, cloud ops, help desk, SOC monitoring, or compliance coordination). We need someone who has made the architecture decisions themselves.



What you'll own



Map the users, information flows, authority boundaries, and risks in the first 48 hours, and recommend the architecture and pilot scope.

Design identity, role-based access, least privilege, approvals, routing, audit logging, and escalation, end to end.

Keep organizations and clients fully separated, including making sure admin rights never automatically mean access to protected data.

Define how access changes as people join, change roles, take temporary authority, and leave.

Define what AI agents can read, write, or send, and what always needs human approval.

Set up or direct the Microsoft 365/Entra ID configuration for the first
 workflow.

Turn business requirements into technical specs and acceptance tests the team can build against.

Run a controlled live pilot, test revocation and edge cases, and get defects fixed.

Document the architecture, SOPs, runbooks, and access records so others can run it.



You must have



Personally designed (not just administered) an access, identity, or security setup that went live. You'll be asked to walk us through it.

Hands-on Microsoft 365 and Entra ID/Azure AD: groups, shared mailboxes, MFA, conditional access, RBAC, audit logs.

Solid grasp of least privilege, separation of duties, access reviews, privileged/temporary access, and i
 response.

Experience setting up multi-client or multi-tenant environments, or separating sensitive data between groups.

Clear spoken and written English. You'll explain technical decisions to a non-technical executive and push back when needed.

Comfort saying "I don't know yet, here's how I'd find out." We value that more than guessing.



Nice to have



Azure Solutions Architect, Microsoft Security, CISSP, or similar certification

ISO 27001 or SOC 2 implementation experience

API and workflow-automation experience

Experience setting permissions for AI agents or service accounts

Consulting or MSP experience building setups for multiple client companies

title: Intake Coordinator

Rigorously track every lead in the firm’s CRM/case management software (e.g., Clio, MyCase) from inquiry to final disposition.

Client Screening & Vetting:



Conduct initial screening interviews with PNCs to gather necessary factual information about their legal matter.

Determine if the prospective matter aligns with the firm’s practice areas and current capacity.

Perform conflict checks immediately upon intake and document the results.



Communication & Nurturing:

title: Group Controller
description:
Key responsibilities:



Close and reporting

• Own the monthly close for all four entities and deliver it within 10 working days, with a documented close checklist.

• Produce monthly management accounts per entity (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and a consolidated group view, including a clear NL vs. HQ split.

• Prepare the monthly investor pack inputs: revenue by country and dealer, gross margin, burn rate, runway, cash position, EBITDA.

• Explain variances: budget vs. actual, month vs. month, with the drivers behind them.



Revenue and settlement control

• Own revenue recognition: platform data, Stripe and the ledger must agree before anything is booked.

• Review dealer settlements and venue/partner commission statements before they go out, and fix root causes when sources disagree.

• Define and maintain the policies behind settlements (e.g. treatment of refunds, non-return fees, adjustments).



Cash and planning

• Maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast and the monthly liquidity plan per entity.

• Update the annual budget and rolling forecast together with the finance lead.

• Monitor payments due and working capital (AR/AP ageing) and flag risks early.



Intercompany and tax

• Own the intercompany framework: payroll cost allocation, management fees, licence/royalty fees, product mark-up, loans and current accounts, reconciled and agreed every month.

• Maintain the schedules needed for transfer-pricing documentation.

• Review NL VAT returns and ICP listings, reverse-charge and intra-Community treatment before filing.

• Coordinate the NL year-end (jaarrekening, VPB) with the external accountant and the HK audit and profits tax with the auditor and company secretary.

• Escalate any VAT or cross-entity question to the external accountant for sign-off; you prepare and review, they confirm.



Bookkeeping (hands-on, decreasing over time)

• Process invoices, bank, Stripe and Airwallex reconciliations, payroll journals and accruals while no separate bookkeeper is in place.

• Write the SOPs that allow this work to be handed to a bookkeeper later, and review that work once it is.



Controls, systems and fixed assets

• Set up and maintain internal controls: approval flows, segregation of duties, reconciliation sign-offs, audit trail.

• Lead the finance side of the Exact Online to Odoo migration: chart of accounts, VAT codes, entity setup, bank feeds, reporting.

• Own the fixed-asset register for the station and power bank fleet and its depreciation.

• Automate recurring work wherever the volume justifies it.



Must have:

• A bachelor's degree or other higher education in accounting, finance or a related field.

• 7+ years in accounting and finance, of which at least 3 in a controller or senior accountant role.

• Experience owning the close and management reporting for a multi-entity group with intercompany flows and consolidation.

• Solid working knowledge of EU VAT mechanics (returns, reverse charge, intra-Community supplies).

• Strong financial modelling in Excel/Google Sheets: cash flow forecasts, budgets, variance analysis.

• Fluent English, written and spoken; able to read Dutch invoices and statements (translation tools are fine).

• Willing and able to do hands-on bookkeeping alongside the controlling work.



Nice to have

• A professional accounting qualification (e.g. CPA, ACCA, CMA).

• Hands-on Dutch VAT, ICP and Dutch GAAP / IFRS experience.

• Experience with Hong Kong entities (audit cycle, profits tax, company secretary).

• Transfer-pricing documentation and royalty/licence flows.

• Odoo or Exact Online, ideally a migration between systems.

• Payment-platform reconciliation (Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex) at high transaction volume.

• Experience serving European clients remotely as an independent freelancer, ideally startups or scale-ups.



How you work

• You own the numbers and flag problems early, with a proposed fix.

• You build processes and controls that scale, and document them so they can be checked, repeated and automated.

• You know where your expertise ends and when to bring in the accountant.



Tools: Exact Online (moving to Odoo), Stripe, Airwallex, ABN AMRO, Revolut, Nmbrs, Google Workspace, Slack, 



Hours: Full-time (40 hrs/week)

Contract: Independent contractor (no agencies or BPO providers)

Compensation: Hourly rate [TBD — in EUR or USD], invoiced monthly

mbers during high-volume periods through effective communication and workload sharing.

title: Customer Support Manager (US Payroll, HR & Benefits Support Team)
description:
Customer Support Manager | Remote | Full Time

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time

(8:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time; 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM from November to March)



People who call our support line usually need a clear answer about something that matters to them: a paycheck, a benefit, a deadline, or an HR question. We're looking for a manager who gets that and can lead a team that answers with accuracy, urgency, and care.



ABOUT COLLABPEO

collabPEO is a US-based PEO (Professional Employer Organization). We handle payroll, employee benefits, HR support, compliance, and risk management for businesses, so they can focus on running their company.



THE ROLE

You'll lead a remote support team of about 10 to 20 people who answer questions from our clients (business owners and managers) and their employees. This is a people-leadership and operations role. You'll stay close enough to the calls to spot recurring issues, but your main job is building a strong team, keeping the queue covered, setting clear expectations, and improving the service experience.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead, coach, and develop a remote support team of 10 to 20 people

- Own daily operations: staffing, scheduling, and queue coverage for the full 8 AM to 5 PM ET window

- Set performance targets and track call quality, response time, resolution, CSAT, abandonment, and schedule adherence

- Run one-on-ones, team huddles, call reviews, and coaching sessions with direct, useful feedback

- Recognize strong performance early and handle performance or attendance issues fairly and consistently

- Build and improve SOPs, workflows, knowledge base articles, and escalation paths so the team can answer correctly without unnecessary transfers

- Work with our HR, payroll, benefits, and compliance specialists to fix recurring issues and keep the team updated

- Review call data and customer feedback, spot patterns, and bring clear recommendations to leadership

- Help with hiring, onboarding, and training as the team grows

- Make sure the team handles sensitive payroll and personal information with strict confidentiality



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least 5 years of call center, contact center, or BPO experience

- At least 2 to 3 years as a Team Leader, Supervisor, or Manager handling 10 or more agents

- A track record of improving team KPIs and customer experience through coaching and clear processes

- Excellent spoken and written English, comfortable with US clients and US business culture

- Comfortable using call center data, QA scores, and customer feedback to make decisions

- Hands-on experience with call center, CRM, ticketing, or workforce management tools

- Organized, dependable, and calm under pressure when volume spikes or questions get complicated



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in a US PEO, payroll, HR services, or employee benefits account

- Experience supporting both business clients and their employees

- Experience managing a fully remote team



WORK SETUP REQUIREMENTS

- Quiet, dedicated workspace suitable for calls and meetings

- Reliable primary internet (at least 25 Mbps) plus a backup connection

- Backup power (UPS or generator) for brownouts

- Noise-canceling headset and a computer that can handle calling and CRM tools at the same time



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clients and their employees see our support line as dependable, and the team finds it well run. Your agents know what's expected, get regular coaching, have the information they need to answer accurately, and know when to bring in a specialist. Leadership has a clear view of performance, recurring issues, and where service can improve.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any step below won't be reviewed.

1. Use this subject line: CSM2026 - [Your Full Name]

2. Attach your resume

3. Answer these two questions in your message:

   a. What was the largest team you managed, and which KPIs were you directly responsible for?

   b. Tell us about an agent whose performance you turned around. What did you do?

4. Include a 1 to 2 minute voice recording (link or file) introducing yourself and describing how you run a team huddle

AI VIDEO EDITOR – REALISTIC AI UGC & PERFORMANCE ADS



Company: Scale Front

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term

Salary: $350–$450 USD per month

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Amsterdam Time (CET/CEST)

ABOUT SCALE FRONT



Scale Front is a growth agency working with established e-commerce brands. We help businesses grow through creative strategy, performance advertising and high-quality content production.



We're building a team of talented AI video editors who can consistently deliver professional, highly realistic and engaging AI-generated content.



We're looking for someone who is genuinely skilled in AI video production, understands how to create realistic content and can turn creative ideas into high-quality advertisements.



This is not a position for someone who only knows how to generate basic AI clips.



We want someone who understands visual storytelling, performance advertising, human realism and professional video editing.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING



Your main responsibility will be creating high-quality AI-generated video advertisements for
, Instagram, TikTok and other social media platforms.



You should be comfortable creating the following types of content:



1. REALISTIC AI UGC VIDEOS



Creating believable AI-generated people, talking-head videos, testimonials, product demonstrations and creator-style advertisements.



The goal is to create AI videos that look almost indistinguishable from real footage.



We're aiming for an extremely high level of realism, ideally around 95/100 or higher.



Facial expressions, body movements, lighting, skin textures, voiceovers and lip-sync must look natural.



2. AI PRODUCT ADVERTISEMENTS



Creating realistic product demonstrations, lifestyle scenes, product-focused advertisements and visually engaging content.



Products must look consistent, realistic and accurately represented throughout the video.



3. AI STORYTELLING VIDEOS



Creating engaging videos with realistic characters, natural environments, compelling storytelling and smooth transitions between scenes.



You should understand how to use visuals to communicate emotions, problems, solutions and product benefits.



4. AI CARTOON & ANIMATED VIDEOS



Creating AI-generated cartoon videos, animated characters, creative storytelling concepts and other engaging animated advertisements.



5. AI B-ROLL



Generating realistic, relevant B-roll footage that supports the script, strengthens the message and keeps viewers interested.



B-roll must match the story and should never feel random or unnecessary.



6. PERFORMANCE-FOCUSED AI ADS



Creating attention-grabbing hooks, problem-solution advertisements, testimonial-style creatives, product ads and direct-response videos.



You should understand how to create videos that are not only visually impressive but also designed to perform in paid advertising campaigns.



7. HOOK VARIATIONS



Creating different visual hooks, opening scenes and creative variations for testing.



You should understand the importance of the first 1–3 seconds of an advertisement.



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Our target is 3 completed high-quality short-form videos per working day.



Your responsibilities include:



- Creating realistic AI-generated video content.

- Following detailed creative briefs, scripts and references.

- Generating believable AI characters.

- Maintaining character consistency across multiple scenes.

- Creating natural facial expressions and body movements.

- Producing realistic lighting, shadows and skin textures.

- Ensuring accurate lip-sync and natural-sounding voiceovers.

- Generating relevant B-roll and supporting footage.

- Editing AI scenes into complete video advertisements.

- Creating strong hooks and engaging storytelling.

- Adding professional subtitles, music and sound effects.

- Ensuring smooth transitions and professional pacing.

- Identifying and correcting AI-generated mistakes.

- Checking your own work carefully before submitting it.

- Delivering completed videos on time.

- Making revisions based on feedback.

- Communicating progress clearly with our creative team.



Most standard short-form videos will be approximately 15–60 seconds.



More complex AI productions, multi-scene projects and advanced animations may require additional production time, which will be discussed separately.



REQUIRED SKILLS



We're looking for someone who has:



- Proven experience creating realistic AI-generated videos.

- Strong understanding of AI video generation and prompting.

- Experience creating realistic AI UGC content.

- Experience with AI-generated characters and character consistency.

- Good understanding of natural human movements, lighting, facial expressions and lip-sync.

- Strong video editing skills.

- Experience creating product advertisements.

- Ability to generate relevant and realistic B-roll.

- Understanding of hooks, storytelling and viewer retention.

- Understanding of performance advertising and direct-response creatives.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to follow detailed creative briefs.

- Fast and reliable communication.

- Ability to work independently.

- Ability to meet deadlines consistently.



AI TOOLS & SOFTWARE



Experience with AI platforms such as Google Veo, Google Flow, Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, HeyGen or similar tools is preferred.



You should also be comfortable editing and polishing videos using professional video editing software.



We do not require you to use one specific program.



What matters most is the final quality of your work.



If you can create outstanding videos consistently, we're interested.



QUALITY STANDARDS



Quality is one of our highest priorities at Scale Front.



We want AI-generated videos that look as realistic as possible.



We pay close attention to:



- Natural facial expressions.

- Realistic body movements.

- Consistent characters across scenes.

- Accurate and believable lip-sync.

- Natural-looking skin textures.

- Realistic lighting and shadows.

- Correct hands, fingers and body proportions.

- Accurate product appearance.

- Smooth transitions.

- Natural voiceovers.

- Professional sound design.

- Strong visual storytelling.

- High-quality editing.

- Attention-grabbing hooks.



We do not accept obvious AI mistakes, unnatural movements, inconsistent characters, poor lip-sync, generic visuals or rushed, low-quality work.



We expect you to review your own work carefully before submitting it.



Our goal is 3 high-quality short-form videos per working day, without sacrificing quality.



Complex productions will have separately agreed production expectations.



WORKING HOURS



Monday to Friday

9:00 AM–5:00 PM Amsterdam Time (CET/CEST)

40 hours per week



You must be available during these working hours.



Please note that Amsterdam follows daylight saving time, so the time difference with the Philippines changes during the year.



SALARY & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



Starting compensation: $350–$450 USD per month.



Your starting salary will depend on your portfolio, experience, skills and demonstrated ability.



We're looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term collaboration.



As Scale Front grows, there may be opportunities for increased compensation, additional responsibilities and professional development based on performance.



We value reliable team members who consistently deliver high-quality work and want to grow with us.



HOW TO APPLY

FINAL STEP – CONTACT ME ON WHATSAPP

We're hiring a SENIOR accounts receivable and B2B collections specialist to own our receivables, from invoicing through to cash in the bank.



This is a senior role. We need someone who can run AR independently, spot problems before they become bad debt, and help us build a better process as we grow.



SCHEDULE: Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm US Eastern time.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Collections:

- Make outbound collection calls and send
s to commercial customers with accounts 30, 60 and 90+ days past due

- Track payment promises and follow up the moment one is missed

- Resolve invoice disputes, short-payments and "we never received it" claims, and escalate when needed

Accounts receivable:

- Create and send customer invoices and submit them through customer vendor portals (Coupa, Yardi, AvidXchange, AppFolio and others)

- Apply incoming payments and clear unapplied cash

- Review new customer credit applications and set credit limits

- Improve our AR process and help train junior staff as the team grows



REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years of hands-on accounts receivable experience, including B2B collections (US clients strongly preferred)

- Confident, clear spoken English. You'll be on the phone with US property managers every day.

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience (or similar accounting software)

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups)

- Proven results, e.g. reducing DSO or recovering aged balances

- Available during US Eastern business hours

- Reliable internet with backup power and a backup connection

- Detail-oriented, organized and comfortable handling sensitive financial information



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience collecting from property management companies, HOAs or construction/trades businesses

- Experience with vendor portals (Coupa, SAP Ariba, AvidXchange, Yardi, Entrata)

- Experience leading or training other AR staff

- A phone dialer such as RingCentral



HOW TO APPLY

Complete our application form, which includes a short voice recording:

title: GoHighLevel Automation Specialist
description:
We're hiring a GoHighLevel (GHL) Automation Specialist to design, build, and maintain the workflows that keep our business running. Our automation needs have grown beyond what our current team can handle, and we need someone who can own GHL builds from start to finish.

You'll turn business processes into reliable automations: lead capture, nurture sequences, pipeline management, appointment booking, and the integrations that connect GHL to the rest of our tools. Light programming skills are a plus, but this is not a full-stack developer role.



Key responsibilities

Build, test, and maintain GHL workflows, triggers, and multi-step automations across our sub-accounts.

Set up and manage pipelines, opportunities, forms, surveys, calendars, and booking flows.

Create
 and SMS nurture campaigns, follow-up sequences, and reminder automations.

Connect GHL to outside tools using Zapier, Make (formerly Integromat), webhooks, and native integrations.

Map data cleanly between systems with custom fields, tags, and custom values.

Troubleshoot broken automations, failed zaps, and sync errors, then fix the root cause.

Audit existing workflows to remove duplicates, close gaps, and improve reliability.

Document each build so the team can understand, use, and maintain it.

Work with sales, marketing, and operations to turn their requests into working automations.



Required qualifications

3+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building workflows, pipelines, and campaigns.

A portfolio or examples of complex GHL automations you've built, with conditional logic, wait steps, and multi-branch paths.

Working experience connecting GHL to other platforms with Zapier, including multi-step zaps, filters, and formatters.

Comfort with webhooks: sending and receiving data between GHL and other systems.

Strong troubleshooting skills and the patience to trace a problem across several tools.

Clear written communication, especially for documenting builds and explaining fixes to non-technical teammates.



Also: 

Basic programming skills, ideally JavaScript and Python, for custom code steps in Zapier, Make, or GHL workflows.

Experience with REST APIs, JSON, and the GHL API, including authentication and API keys.

Familiarity with other automation tools such as Make, n8n, and Pabbly Connect.

Experience integrating GHL with common tools like Stripe, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, Calendly, Slack, or
 and Google Ads.

Basic HTML and CSS for funnel and website tweaks.

Experience with GHL snapshots, SaaS mode, or agency-level account management.

Understanding of A2P 10DLC registration and
 deliverability basics (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).



Who will thrive here

You think in systems and enjoy mapping out how a lead moves from first touch to closed deal.

You test before you launch and care about catching edge cases.

You work independently, manage several builds at once, and flag blockers early.

You like learning new tools and keep up with GHL's frequent feature updates.

You'd rather build something simple that works than something clever that breaks.

You are a self starter

PAY AND HOURS

title: Creative Strategist - DTC Ecommerce / Meta Ads
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing US-focused DTC ecommerce brand looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to take ownership of our paid social creative testing pipeline. 



In this role, you will lead the creative engine end-to-end: conducting deep customer research, developing angles grounded in consumer psychology, producing production-ready briefs for editors and creators, analyzing post-launch ad performance, and systematically iterating on winning creative.



If you know how to turn customer pain points and data into high-converting Meta ads that scale—and you have a repeatable system for doing it—we want to work with you.



---



Key Responsibilities

- Customer & Market Research: Dive deep into customer reviews, competitor ads, TikTok/Reels trends, Reddit, and forums to uncover fresh psychological angles, unaddressed pain points, and hook opportunities.

- Concept & Angle Development: Formulate clear creative hypotheses and concepts across multiple direct-response formats (UGC, founder/brand story, problem-solution, unboxing, press/PR, native TikTok style, and high-impact statics).

- High-Volume Briefing: Build detailed, production-ready creative briefs for video editors and UGC creators—complete with visual directions, hook variations, copy/voiceover scripts, text overlays, and pacing notes.

- Performance Analysis & Iteration: Review Meta Ads Manager and attribution data weekly alongside the media buying team. Break down *why* an ad won or lost (thumbstop rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and rapidly produce iteration batches (new hooks, different lead-ins, CTA shifts).

- Creative Systems & Velocity: Help refine and document our creative strategy SOPs, swipe files, and testing frameworks to maintain a predictable, high-velocity creative testing pipeline.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders, media buyers, editors, and creators to ensure creative runs smoothly from ideation to launch.



---



Qualifications & Requirements

- Proven track record on Meta Ads 
 & Instagram): You understand direct-response fundamentals, thumbstop rates (3-second hook rate), hold rates, CTR, and how creative dictates cost per acquisition.

- Direct-Response & Consumer Psychology: Deep understanding of customer awareness stages (problem-aware, solution-aware, product-aware) and how to write hooks that stop the scroll.

- High-Quality Briefing Skills: Ability to write clear, foolproof briefs that editors and creators can execute without endless back-and-forth.

- Industry Experience: Direct experience in DTC physical products (wellness, home goods, sleep, health, beauty, or hardware) is a huge plus.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet, dependable workstation, and strong written English communication skills.

- Ability to work US hours.



---



Role Details

- Position: Full-Time Independent Contractor (40 hours/week)

- Location: 100% Remote (Philippines-based)

- Hours: Overlap required with US working hours for syncs and team communication.

- Growth: Stable, long-term position with room to grow alongside the brand.



---



How to Apply

Please provide:



1. Scalable Win (Brief & Angle): Share a link to (or attachment of) one actual creative brief you personally wrote for an ad that successfully scaled. Explain the core psychological angle behind it and why you believe it worked.

2. End-to-End Case Study: Walk us through one specific creative you took from initial customer research and briefing through to live launch data, what you learned from the metrics, and how you iterated on it.

3. Capacity & Output: In a typical 40-hour week, how many production-ready briefs can you comfortably deliver, and how many hook/asset variations does each brief typically yield?

4. Links: Provide a link to your portfolio, swipe file, or examples of previous creative work/briefs (Google Drive, Notion, Loom, or PDF).

title: EA to the Founder / Social Media and Podcast Production
description:
This key role supports Strong Start Early Care & Education and Wired to Thrive, collaborating directly with Founder & Owner Marc Hoffman to advance strategic objectives and foster operational excellence across both entities.



This unique role serves as an immersive business opportunity. Working side-by-side with Marc, you will gain an inside view of executive decision-making.



Along with executive and administrative support, this role includes hands-on social media execution and video editing. You will turn approved ideas and recorded material into finished content, manage publication, and track results while developing broader project ownership and operational leadership.



You are expected to take ownership of assigned priorities and follow them through to completion with sound judgment, discretion, and initiative. The role is intentionally broad and may include both significant business initiatives and routine administrative or personal support; however, priorities will be managed within a given workweek.



Responsibilities may range from coordinating significant business projects to handling straightforward administrative or personal requests, such as making a reservation, purchasing a gift, or ordering flowers. In every case, the expectation is the same: understand the desired outcome, exercise sound judgment, anticipate what is needed, and complete the task fully and correctly. When competing priorities exceed available capacity, Marc and the EA will determine which responsibilities take precedence.



Role & Responsibilities



The responsibilities below reflect the current scope of the role and may evolve as business needs change. Material expansion of responsibilities will be considered as part of workload, hours, title, and compensation reviews rather than assumed to fit automatically within the existing schedule.



The responsibilities below represent the range of areas the role supports rather than tasks expected to be performed simultaneously. Executive support, podcast producing, social media execution, and video editing are core responsibilities. Marc and the EA will agree on priority accounts, posting frequency, editing deliverables, turnaround times, and time allocation within the agreed-upon work schedule.



Executive Support to Marc



You will work closely with Marc to facilitate executive decision-making, protect his time, organize priorities, and ensure high-priority business goals move forward.



• Managing and coordinating Marc’s calendar, meetings, appointments, and scheduling.

• Keeping track of priorities, commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items.

• Preparing meeting notes, agendas, research, presentations, and other materials as needed.

• Managing executive communications and relationships with key partners, vendors, advisors, and other stakeholders.

• Liaising across teams and leadership to ensure alignment on cross-functional initiatives.

• Overseeing complex, multi-brand projects spanning Strong Start and Wired to Thrive.

• Identifying outstanding items and proactively bringing them to Marc’s attention.

• Translating Marc’s ideas, discussions, and decisions into clearly defined action items and ensuring they are completed.

• Designing operational frameworks and systems that improve executive productivity and streamline workflow.

• Exercising extreme discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential strategic, personal, and financial information.

• Providing high-touch operational assistance as needed to preserve Marc’s executive bandwidth.

• Assisting with personal and household management for Marc, including domestic organization and childcare coordination.

• Anticipating needs rather than waiting for every task to be specifically assigned.



Wired to Thrive Podcast and Content Operations



You will play a key role in developing Wired to Thrive into a broader content platform and personal brand, owning the workflow from guest preparation through content creation and publication. Hands-on editing and social media responsibilities also support Marc's personal brand and Strong Start through the accounts and projects assigned by Marc.



• Researching and identifying compelling potential podcast guests who align with Wired to Thrive's themes and audience.

• Developing a consistent pipeline of potential guests, including entrepreneurs, neurodiversity advocates, researchers, educators, psychologists, creators, parents, and individuals with compelling personal stories.

• Evaluating potential guests and presenting Marc with concise recommendations explaining why each person would make a strong guest and the potential episode angle.

• Conducting initial outreach to prospective guests and managing communication throughout the booking process.

• Building and maintaining relationships with current, prospective, and previous podcast guests.

• Coordinating guest scheduling, confirmations, reminders, bios, headshots, social links, releases, and other required materials.

• Conducting brief pre-interviews or preparation calls with selected guests to identify important stories, perspectives, themes, and potential discussion areas.

• Researching guests before recordings and preparing concise briefing documents for Marc.

• Developing thoughtful interview questions and episode angles designed to generate substantive and engaging conversations rather than generic interviews.

• Identifying stories, perspectives, and questions that Marc may want to explore during each conversation.

• Participating in podcast recordings as needed to support Marc and the guest, monitor the discussion, identify important moments, and capture potential follow-up questions.

• Coordinating the complete podcast production workflow from guest booking through publication.

• Managing communication with editors, producers, designers, and other podcast vendors when specialist support is needed, while personally completing routine video edits and social media deliverables.

• Tracking each episode through recording, editing, review, approval, publication, and promotion.

• Reviewing episode materials for accuracy, completeness, quality, and brand consistency.

• Ensuring podcast deliverables and deadlines do not fall through the cracks.

• Identifying strong moments from interviews and personally editing them into polished short-form videos, reels, and promotional clips with clear hooks and engaging pacing.

• Editing footage by trimming and sequencing clips, removing unnecessary pauses, adding accurate captions and branded graphics, making basic audio and color adjustments, and exporting versions suited to each assigned platform.

• Completing straightforward edits to longer videos or podcast episodes as agreed with Marc, and coordinating specialist support for advanced production work.

• Maintaining organized source footage, project files, approved assets, and final exports so content can be found and reused easily.

• Using AI tools to efficiently analyze transcripts, identify themes, develop content ideas, conduct research, and improve the podcast production process.

• Working with Marc to develop ideas for solo episodes based on recurring themes, audience interests, personal experiences, and conversations from guest episodes.

• Developing potential episode titles, descriptions, hooks, social copy, and promotional concepts.

• Owning day-to-day social media execution for assigned Wired to Thrive, Marc Hoffman, and Strong Start accounts, including maintaining a content calendar, preparing posts, obtaining required approvals, scheduling, and publishing.

• Adapting captions, hooks, thumbnails, graphics, and video formats to each assigned platform while maintaining the distinct voice and audience of each brand.

• Monitoring comments and direct messages, responding to routine inquiries within agreed guidelines, and escalating sensitive questions or issues to Marc or the appropriate team member.

• Checking content for accuracy, caption quality, brand consistency, and required permissions before publication, including approval to use images or footage of children and families.

• Helping guests promote their episodes by providing them with links, clips, graphics, and other relevant materials.

• Tracking podcast and social media performance and providing a concise monthly report on publishing consistency, reach, engagement, watch time, audience growth, and relevant inquiries or conversions where tracking is available. Using these findings to recommend and test improvements to topics, hooks, clips, and formats.

• Researching other podcasts, conferences, media opportunities, and platforms where Marc could appear as a guest.

• Proactively identifying partnerships, collaborations, guests, and opportunities that can increase the reach and influence of Wired to Thrive.

• Helping build and maintain a long-term network of podcast guests, thought leaders, creators, media contacts, and strategic relationships around the Wired to Thrive brand.



The objective is for Marc to be able to focus primarily on showing up prepared and having an exceptional conversation, while helping ensure that everything surrounding the episode is organized, executed, distributed, and leveraged effectively.



AI Implementation & Business Intelligence



You will help Marc identify practical ways to incorporate AI into his businesses and personal workflow.



• Researching AI tools and emerging technologies relevant to Strong Start, Wired to Thrive, and Marc's executive workflow.

• Using AI to accelerate research, writing, analysis, meeting preparation, content development, and administrative work.

• Creating repeatable prompts, workflows, templates, and processes.

• Helping team members understand how to use AI effectively and responsibly.

• Identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated or streamlined.

• Evaluating whether AI-generated work is accurate and appropriate before it is used.

• Helping Marc quickly synthesize large amounts of information into concise, actionable insights.

• Continuously looking for opportunities to improve speed, quality, and productivity through technology.



Qualifications



Required:



• A minimum of 5 years of relevant executive-assistance or administrative experience is required.

• Experience directly supporting a founder, CEO, business owner, or senior executive.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S.-based stakeholders.

• Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through. Taking initiative is a must: you must proactively identify what needs to be done, anticipate needs, propose solutions, and move work forward independently without waiting for repeated instructions.

• Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office and familiarity with project-management systems.

• Demonstrated practical use of modern AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or comparable platforms for research, writing, analysis, organization, or workflow improvement.

• Ability to research unfamiliar topics, synthesize information, and turn discussions into clear next steps.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience managing social media accounts, maintaining content calendars, writing platform-appropriate copy, scheduling and publishing posts, and reporting on performance.

• Practical video-editing proficiency with tools such as CapCut, Descript, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable software, including short-form storytelling, captions, basic audio cleanup, and platform-specific exports.

• Ability to create simple branded graphics and thumbnails using Canva or comparable tools.

• A portfolio or work samples showing videos personally edited and social media content personally created or managed, with a clear explanation of the candidate's contribution.



Preferred:



• Experience supporting a U.S.-based or international executive remotely.

• Experience with podcast production, founder-led personal brands, education or childcare marketing, and coordination with creative specialists.

• Familiarity with automation tools and process improvement.

• A college degree is not required; relevant experience, judgment, communication, and demonstrated capability will carry greater weight.



What Success in This Role Looks Like



Success will mean that:



• Marc has greater visibility and control over his priorities, commitments, and projects.

• Important follow-ups and projects do not fall through the cracks.

• Marc spends less time managing administrative details and more time on decisions, relationships, creativity, and high-value work.

• You increasingly anticipate what Marc will need before he asks for it.

• Projects move forward without Marc having to repeatedly check their status.

• Wired to Thrive develops a strong and consistent pipeline of compelling guests.

• Podcast guests have a professional, organized, and welcoming experience.

• Marc enters interviews well-prepared without being overloaded with unnecessary information.

• Podcast recordings are consistently turned into finished video clips and social posts that meet agreed quality standards and publication deadlines.

• Assigned social accounts maintain a reliable publishing schedule, timely routine community responses, and a consistent brand voice.

• Marc receives concise monthly content reports with clear recommendations grounded in performance data.

• Wired to Thrive becomes increasingly organized, visible, influential, and measurable as a platform.

• Marc receives concise information that helps him make better and faster decisions.

• AI becomes a practical part of how the team works rather than simply another technology initiative.

• You increasingly take ownership of these areas and independently move work forward while understanding when Marc needs to be involved.



Moving Forward



We see this as an opportunity to build a long-term partnership and grow into a broader and increasingly influential role as performance, judgment, and organizational impact are demonstrated.



You will have direct exposure to the founder, significant ownership of important initiatives, and the opportunity to help shape how Strong Start and Wired to Thrive operate and grow.



As your understanding of Marc, the businesses, and their priorities develops, the expectation is that you will require progressively less direction and take increasing responsibility for identifying what needs to happen, developing a plan, and moving it forward.



We will work together to establish clear priorities, expectations, and measurable goals, including the accounts you own, weekly content and editing deliverables, approval procedures, response expectations, and the balance between executive support and content work.



Performance will be formally reviewed after 90 days to calibrate priorities and expectations, after six months for a performance and compensation review, and annually thereafter. Strong performance, demonstrated ownership, increased executive leverage, and a material expansion in responsibilities may result in an adjustment to compensation, hours, title, or role scope.



Miscellaneous



• During the two-week trial period, either party may terminate the agreement at any time.

• The company may use basic time-tracking software for work-hour accountability.

description:

• Paid per finished video, at the price you quote: one price per body, one price per hook. Revisions are included until the video is approved.

Compensation: $1,000 to $1,200 USD per month, based on experience and test task results. Paid monthly. Raises are tied to performance and responsibility.



About Us



EMS Mastermind is a direct-response marketing agency for Electro Muscle Stimulation (EMS) fitness studios in the US and internationally. We run lead generation, Meta ads, offer optimization, and CRM automation for about a dozen active studio clients. We care about performance, honesty, and doing the work right the first time.

Make optimization calls within clear guidelines (scaling, pausing, budget shifts, refreshes)

Build and manage custom and lookalike audiences

Update ad copy and creatives across accounts

Prepare clear performance summaries for client accounts

Tracking and Setup

Configure and troubleshoot standard and custom events, event match quality, and deduplication

Connect tracking between landing pages, forms, GoHighLevel, and Meta

Test every workflow before it goes live



Operations

Follow our brand and copy standards exactly



What We’re Looking For



2+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience managing real budgets for lead generation (not just ecommerce)

Proven experience setting up Pixels and CAPI, including troubleshooting event match quality and tracking issues

Strong understanding of lead gen metrics: CPL, cost per booked appointment, show rate, and creative fatigue

Experience with local service, fitness, or wellness businesses

Experience with Google Tag Manager or server-side tracking



Our Copy Standards (you’ll be trained on these)

Short, punchy lines. No em-dashes, no generic AI-sounding phrases, no fluff. Copy should explain how something works, not just promise results.



How to Apply



Please include:

Your availability and time zone

Start your application with the word “Mastermind” so I know you read this

title: Crypto BD Team Lead: $1,500-2,500/mo Base Pace + Uncapped Deal Bonuses (Remote)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: AI Creative Specialist
description:
TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here:

airtable (dot) com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.



Applications submitted through onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads,
 campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term team member who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via
, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Commitment to the company's mission and values, which can be found here: 
/3Unr0ub



- Excel as a team player, contributing positively to our collective success.





ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS



HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. We've been family-owned and operated since 2005, now in our second generation of leadership, and are headquartered in Dallas, Texas.

Our growth has been recognized nationally: we've been named to the Inc. 5000 (a prestigious list of America's fastest-growing private companies) two years running, and have received multiple industry awards for product excellence.



We're a company of around 45 people, small enough that every person matters, established enough that you're joining something real and growing.
