title: Packaging & Graphic Designer
description:
Packaging & Graphic Designer

 

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our team. We are a small but busy company selling worldwide on Amazon, eBay, Walmart and our own Shopify website - and we're now expanding into retail outlets too. We're looking for a talented designer to join our creative team, primarily focused on packaging design as we bring our products to retail shelves.

 

A strong portfolio of retail packaging design is required - we need to see print-ready artwork, not just digital renders.

 

The ideal applicant needs to be highly skilled at Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator, with a solid understanding of print production (dielines, CMYK, bleed, spot colours), and comfortable working with print-ready file formats (e.g. AI, PDF, layered PSD, dieline templates).

 

Previous experience with HTML
 campaigns (e.g. Klaviyo) is a hugely advantageous skill, as is video editing and/or 3D rendering experience.

 

You'll thrive in this role if you:

• Are comfortable using AI tools (e.g. Photoshop generative fill, Midjourney) to speed up concepting and mockups

• Work quickly and efficiently, comfortable managing 2-3 packaging projects at once within a 4-hour window

• Have a sharp eye for detail and can accurately reference/match existing brand packaging systems

• Have excellent alignment and layout skills, with a precise, methodical approach to artwork

• Follow brand guidelines precisely across every project



Your duties will include:

• Work closely with our Product Development team to create new packaging designs based on brand guidelines and feedback from the director/team

• Design print-ready, dieline-accurate retail packaging artwork (boxes, cartons, labels)

• Design instruction booklets and product inserts

• Ensure all packaging and print artwork strictly follows brand guidelines

• Ensure packaging designs meet all relevant compliance requirements

• Create Amazon product images and support A+ Content/EBC as required

• Create and edit
 campaign imagery (occasional)

• Handle other day-to-day photo/design editing tasks as needed



Highly advantageous skills:

• HTML
 campaign experience (e.g. Klaviyo)

• Video editing experience (Adobe After Effects and/or Premiere)

• 3D render experience (for packaging mockups/previews)



We're ideally looking for someone who is already fully trained and comfortable across these skills, though we can provide further training in specific areas if needed.

 

Please note: this is a part-time role, so we understand you may take on other work. However, the hours you commit to us must be fully dedicated to us - please don't schedule other jobs, clients, or tasks during your working hours with us.



Hours: 10am - 2pm (UK time)

 

Please make sure to supply links to your portfolio - packaging/print design examples are especially important for this role.

 

Only applications with a portfolio will be considered.

title: Excel Expert Needed to Create a Complete Wedding Planner Spreadsheet + English Video Tutorial
description:
Project Requirements

1. Create a Comprehensive Wedding Planner Excel Workbook



The workbook should cover everything someone would reasonably need to plan and organize a wedding, including but not limited to:



Wedding Dashboard: An overview of the wedding date, days remaining, planning progress, budget, and important tasks.

Wedding Budget Tracker: Estimated versus actual costs, deposits, balances due, payment deadlines, and budget summaries.

Guest List Manager: Guest names, contact details, RSVP status, meal preferences, dietary restrictions, plus-one information, and other useful notes.

Seating Chart Planner: A system to organize guests by table and manage seating arrangements.

Vendor Tracker: A place to manage venues, caterers, photographers, florists, DJs, officiants, and other vendors, including quotes, contracts, contact information, and payment schedules.

Wedding Checklist and Timeline: Tasks organized by timeframe, priority, status, and deadline, from the early planning stages through the wedding day.

Wedding Day Schedule: A detailed timeline covering preparations, ceremony, photographs, reception, speeches, entertainment, and other important events.

Venue and Vendor Comparison: Tools to compare options, prices, packages, and notes before making decisions.

Invitation and RSVP Tracker: Invitation status, send dates, responses, follow-ups, and guest attendance.

Attire and Beauty Planner: Wedding dress or suit, fittings, alterations, accessories, hair, makeup, and appointments.

Decorations and Flowers: Ideas, suppliers, costs, quantities, and purchasing checklists.

Menu and Catering Planner: Menu choices, dietary requirements, drinks, catering costs, and final guest counts.

Photography and Entertainment: Shot lists, music preferences, special requests, and entertainment arrangements.

Honeymoon and Travel Planner: Travel details, accommodation, transportation, and related costs.

Notes and Ideas: Space for inspiration, decisions, links, and miscellaneous wedding details.

These are suggested categories. I welcome your professional recommendations for additional tabs, features, or improvements that would make the workbook more useful.



2. Excel Functionality and Design

The spreadsheet must be more than a basic collection of tables. I want a polished, professional product with an attractive and consistent design.



Ideally, it should include:



A beautiful, cohesive visual design with professional formatting.

Easy navigation between worksheets.

Formulas that automatically calculate totals, remaining balances, budget differences, and completion percentages.

Drop-down menus, checkboxes where supported, and conditional formatting where appropriate.

Progress trackers and visual summaries.

Automatic updates to dashboard figures when information is entered or changed.

Clear instructions and examples to help first-time users understand what to enter.

Appropriate data validation and error prevention.

Compatibility with commonly used desktop versions of Microsoft Excel.

The workbook should be practical and intuitive for beginners while still taking advantage of Excel's capabilities. Please avoid unnecessary complexity or features that make it difficult to use.



3. Record a Video Tutorial in English

Once the spreadsheet is complete, you must record a clear and professional video tutorial explaining how to use it.



The video must:



Be presented in clear, understandable spoken English.

Include a screen recording showing the actual Excel workbook.

Walk through the workbook tab by tab and explain the purpose of each section.

Demonstrate how to enter information and use the main features, formulas, drop-downs, and trackers.

Explain how to update the budget, guest list, vendors, checklist, and dashboard.

Show how someone can use the spreadsheet throughout their wedding planning process.

Be well-paced, organized, and easy for a beginner to follow.

Have clear audio and a readable screen recording.

Be suitable for sharing with other people.

You must be comfortable recording yourself and speaking on camera, at least for an introduction or other relevant portions of the tutorial. I do not want someone who is only comfortable creating the spreadsheet but is unwilling to record a video or have their recording shared.



Important: The finished tutorial must be your own recording, and you must have the right to provide me with permission to share the video with others.



4. Deliverables

The successful freelancer will provide:



The completed Excel wedding planner workbook in editable .xlsx format.

A polished, fully functional spreadsheet with all agreed-upon features.

A recorded video tutorial explaining how to use the workbook.

The final video file in a commonly used format, such as MP4.

Any supporting instructions or a quick-start guide needed to help users get started.

A final review to check formulas, links, navigation, and functionality before delivery.

Ideal Candidate

You should have:



Advanced Excel skills and experience building complex, well-organized workbooks.

Experience with formulas, conditional formatting, data validation, dashboards, and automated calculations.

A strong eye for design and the ability to create visually appealing spreadsheets.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Confidence speaking on camera and recording a screen-sharing tutorial.

The ability to explain technical steps in a simple, beginner-friendly way.

Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication skills.

The ability to deliver a polished, professional final product.

Experience creating planners, trackers, budgeting tools, project management templates, or wedding-related resources is a plus.



When Applying, Please Include

Examples of Excel workbooks or dashboards you have created, preferably with a polished design.

A brief description of your experience building automated Excel templates.

Confirmation that you are comfortable speaking English, recording yourself on camera, and creating a tutorial that will be shared with others.

A short sample of a screen-recorded tutorial you have made, if available.

Your proposed timeline and fixed-price quote for the entire project, including the workbook and video tutorial.

Any suggestions you have for making this wedding planner more comprehensive, attractive, and easy to use.

I am looking for someone who takes pride in their work and can create something genuinely useful, professional, and enjoyable to use.



Please apply only if you are confident you can deliver both the Excel workbook and the recorded English video tutorial.

title: Senior Marketing Executive Assistant
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 Hours per Week)

Reports To: Director of Marketing Services



About Us

We are a fast-growing marketing department supporting multiple brands, product launches, partnerships, affiliates, podcasts, university internship programs, and digital marketing initiatives around the world.

Our team moves quickly, manages dozens of projects simultaneously, and values organization, communication, accountability, and continuous improvement.

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Marketing Executive Assistant who can become the operational hub of our Marketing Services department and help ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



About the Role

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

You'll work directly with the Director of Marketing Serivces to help keep our marketing department organized, on schedule, and operating efficiently. This role is focused on project coordination, organization, communication, and follow-through across a wide variety of marketing initiatives.

You'll help track priorities, organize information, coordinate with internal team members and external partners, and ensure leadership always has visibility into what needs attention.

If you enjoy bringing order to fast-paced environments and thrive on keeping people and projects organized, we'd love to meet you.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Executive Organization & Communication

Help manage executive priorities by organizing
s, tracking action items, monitoring deadlines, and ensuring important requests receive timely follow-up.

- Marketing Project Coordination

Maintain our marketing project tracker and help monitor the progress of ongoing initiatives across multiple teams, ensuring projects remain organized and on schedule.

- Project Management Support

Assist with organizing projects in Asana, maintaining timelines, assigning tasks, and helping teams stay aligned throughout each project.

- Podcast & Partnership Coordination

Help track podcast interviews, partnerships, affiliate requests, product shipments, and other marketing collaborations by monitoring communication and following up on outstanding items.

- University Internship Program

Support the coordination of our university internship program by attending weekly meetings, tracking assignments, monitoring progress, and helping ensure clear communication between our team and the interns.

- Executive Review Coordination

Organize presentations, creative projects, reports, and other materials requiring leadership review so deadlines and approvals remain on track.

-Marketing Operations

Maintain centralized project dashboards, organize supporting documentation, and help ensure our marketing department has accurate, up-to-date information across ongoing initiatives.

- Reporting Coordination

Assist with organizing recurring marketing reports and preparing summaries using information provided by other members of the marketing team.

- Vendor & Agency Coordination

Help coordinate communication with outside agencies, freelancers, and vendors by tracking timelines, deliverables, meeting notes, and outstanding action items.

- Influencer & Partnership Tracking

Maintain organized records for influencer campaigns, partnerships, and marketing collaborations, ensuring important information is easy to access and up to date.

- SOP & Resource Organization

Assist with organizing marketing documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and shared marketing resources as our department continues to grow.



Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is naturally organized, dependable, and proactive.

Marketing experience is helpful, but not required. We're far more interested in finding someone who enjoys creating structure, managing details, and helping busy teams stay organized.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following roles is preferred:

Executive Assistant | Senior Administrative Assistant | Marketing Assistant | Marketing Coordinator

Project Coordinator | Operations Coordinator | Virtual Executive Assistant |Project Management Assistant |Marketing Operations Assistant |Experience supporting executives, directors, or leadership teams is highly preferred.



Preferred Software Experience

Experience with the following tools is a plus:

Google Workspace | Asana | Slack | Basecamp | Notion | Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

WhatsApp | Zoom | Experience with marketing platforms such as WordPress, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, or Google Analytics is beneficial but not required.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

- The ideal candidate is someone who:

- Is exceptionally organized and detail-oriented.

- Takes ownership and follows through without being asked.

- Communicates professionally in English.

- Can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Learns new software and systems quickly.

- Works well independently while collaborating with a team.

- Enjoys solving problems and improving processes.

- Maintains professionalism and confidentiality.

- Has a positive attitude and enjoys helping others succeed.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES: 

This role is designed to grow with the right person.

As you become familiar with our business and marketing operations, you'll have opportunities to expand your responsibilities and develop into one of several specialized career paths within our Marketing Services department. We believe in promoting from within and investing in team members who demonstrate initiative, reliability, and a commitment to excellence.



COMPENSATION: 

Compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. Additional opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and performance-based salary reviews are available.



SUCESS IN THIS ROLE: \

The right person for this position is someone who enjoys helping others stay organized, takes pride in exceptional follow-through, and finds satisfaction in making sure projects move forward efficiently.

If you're someone who naturally brings order to busy environments and enjoys supporting a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.







RECAP OF CORE RESPONSIBILITIES: 

While every day is a little different, your primary responsibilities will include:

Keeping the Director of Marketing organized by tracking action items, deadlines, and priorities.

Monitoring multiple marketing projects to ensure they stay on schedule and nothing falls through the cracks.

Coordinating communication between internal team members, agencies, partners, vendors, and interns.

Organizing projects and timelines within Asana and maintaining our department's project tracker.

Monitoring
s, Slack, Basecamp, and other communication channels to identify important follow-up items.

Preparing simple status updates and summaries so leadership has clear visibility into ongoing projects.

Maintaining organized documentation, project resources, and supporting files across the marketing department.

Following up with team members to ensure tasks are completed on time and projects continue moving forward.

No two days will look exactly the same, but your role will always revolve around one core mission: keeping our marketing department organized, informed, and moving forward.

title: GoHighLevel (GHL) Systems Specialist — Part-Time | Existing Systems & Automation
description:
Long-term, part-time independent contractor.

FirstEditing is an established professional editing company serving authors, academics, and writers worldwide since 1993.



We are hiring an experienced GoHighLevel Specialist to take responsibility for our existing GHL systems, complete unfinished projects, troubleshoot integrations, and keep our sales and communication workflows operating reliably.



**This is not a new GHL setup or general virtual assistant position.**



We already have substantial systems in place. We need someone who can understand what exists, preserve working configurations, resolve problems, and complete assignments independently.



### Responsibilities



- Maintain and troubleshoot existing GHL workflows, funnels, forms, custom fields, and automations.

- Complete our funnel for Book Formatting: pricing, checkout, payment, and customer-intake funnel.

- Finalize and validate our AI chatbot integration and customer routing.

- Support our existing custom PHP/MySQL CRM-to-GHL integration, coordinating directly with our CRM developer.

- Maintain newsletter workflows, subscriptions, unsubscribes, contact synchronization, and
 delivery.

- Support GHL phone system & activation, SMS initiation, WhatsApp integration, and customer communication systems, as we transition from our old custom, bespoke CRM and stack.

- Troubleshoot integrations, webhooks, payment workflows, and contact data issues.

- Coordinate directly with our WordPress, CRM, and newsletter contractors.

- Perform controlled end-to-end testing and document whether the actual business outcome passes or fails.



### Required Qualifications



- At least 2 years of substantial hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- Proven experience troubleshooting existing GHL accounts, not just building new funnels.

- Strong understanding of workflows, triggers, conditional logic, custom fields, contact management, and opportunities.

- Experience with webhooks, APIs, and integrations involving external CRM systems.

- Experience with GHL payments, checkout forms, and Stripe integrations.

- Experience with
 workflows, deliverability, subscription management, and suppression rules.

- Ability to troubleshoot existing systems without introducing unnecessary complexity.

title: Construction Compliance Specialist | Licensing, Insurance & Certified Payroll
description:
We are looking for an experienced Construction Compliance Specialist to manage contractor licensing, insurance compliance, certified payroll, prevailing wage requirements, GC prequalification, and regulatory registrations for our growing U.S. construction operation.



This role sits at the center of our operations and is responsible for making sure our company and projects remain licensed, insured, compliant, and ready to operate, bid, mobilize, and get paid.



The ideal candidate has experience supporting U.S. construction companies, contractors, subcontractors, or general contractors and is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple deadlines across states, projects, and compliance requirements.



Key Responsibilities



Licensing & Business Registration



Maintain contractor licenses and business registrations across all states where we operate.



Track license and registration renewal deadlines and state filing calendars.



Proactively coordinate renewals before expiration.



Maintain the company's status on approved subcontractor/vendor lists with general contractors.



Keep compliance records and documentation organized and up to date.



Insurance, Bonding & COI Management



Maintain Certificates of Insurance (COIs) according to the specific requirements of general contractors and project owners.



Track insurance expiration dates and required coverage.



Manage state-specific workers' compensation requirements, including states that require direct accounts.



Coordinate bonding requirements for government and commercial contracts.



Assemble complete compliance packages prior to project mobilization.



Follow up with insurance providers, brokers, and internal teams to resolve documentation issues.



Prevailing Wage & Certified Payroll



Determine whether projects are subject to Davis-Bacon, state prevailing wage laws, or both.



Research and obtain the appropriate wage determinations.



Manage California public works compliance, including DIR registration, DAS filings, and eCPR submissions.



Prepare and submit certified payroll reports accurately and on schedule.



Respond to agency inquiries related to certified payroll and prevailing wage requirements.



Notify the accounting/payroll team in writing of wage rates, classifications, and reporting schedules before payroll runs.



Maintain organized records of wage determinations, classifications, and payroll compliance documentation.



Federal Contracting



Maintain 
 registration and keep CAGE, UEI, and related identifiers current.



Maintain agency-specific portal registrations required for federal contracting.



Monitor registration requirements and renewal deadlines.



GC Prequalification & Vendor Portals



Complete and maintain general contractor prequalification applications.



Set up and maintain company accounts across compliance and payment platforms such as:



ISNetworld



Avetta



Textura



Procore



LCPTracker



Upload and maintain required company, insurance, safety, financial, and compliance documentation.



Maintain a detailed prequalification and compliance status log.



Identify upcoming expirations, missing documentation, or compliance lapses before they affect bidding, mobilization, or payment.



Payment Compliance & Project Closeout



Confirm compliance and certified payroll status before pay applications are submitted.



Coordinate with accounting and project management to resolve compliance issues that could delay billing.



Support project closeout requirements.



Assist with lien waivers, retention release documentation, and other payment compliance requirements.



Maintain accurate records throughout the project lifecycle.



Qualifications



Required



Experience in construction compliance, contractor/subcontractor administration, construction operations, contract administration, or a related field.



Experience supporting U.S. construction companies, contractors, subcontractors, or general contractors is strongly preferred.



Strong understanding of compliance documentation, deadlines, and administrative processes.



Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple deadlines across different states, projects, and entities without dropping requirements.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to independently track issues, follow up with stakeholders, and proactively prevent compliance lapses.



Proficiency with Google Drive and Microsoft Office.



Comfortable learning and working across multiple online platforms and databases.



Preferred Experience



Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued:



Contractor licensing and state registrations



General contractor prequalification



Insurance compliance and Certificates of Insurance (COIs)



Workers' compensation requirements



Prevailing wage compliance



Davis-Bacon requirements



Certified payroll



California DIR



California DAS



California eCPR







CAGE / UEI



ISNetworld



Avetta



Textura



Procore



LCPTracker



Salesforce



Airtable



California public works and certified payroll experience is a strong advantage.



The Ideal Candidate



You are highly organized, proactive, and comfortable being the person responsible for making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You naturally think:



"What expires next, what is missing, and what could prevent this project from moving forward?"



You don't wait until a license expires, a GC rejects a COI, or certified payroll is due to discover a problem.



You proactively monitor deadlines, maintain accurate records, communicate with stakeholders, and make sure requirements are completed before they become an issue.



You should also be comfortable communicating with:



General contractors



Project managers



Accounting and payroll teams



Insurance brokers



Government agencies



Vendors and subcontractors



Internal leadership



Because this position touches licensing, insurance, payroll, contracts, billing, and project operations, strong attention to detail and ownership are essential.



Why Join Us?



This role sits at the center of the business and provides direct visibility into how a national contracting operation runs.



As the company continues to grow, there is room to expand your responsibilities into broader areas such as:



Construction compliance



Risk management



Contract administration



Vendor management



Regulatory compliance



Construction operations



If you have experience in construction compliance, contractor administration, certified payroll, prevailing wage, licensing, insurance compliance, or GC prequalification, we'd love to hear from you.



Screening Questions



1. Construction Compliance Experience



How many years of experience do you have working in construction compliance, contractor/subcontractor administration, construction operations, or a related role supporting U.S. clients? Please briefly describe your experience and responsibilities.



2. Compliance Systems & Regulations



Which of the following have you personally worked with? Select all that apply and briefly explain your experience: Contractor Licensing, COI/Insurance Compliance, Prevailing Wage, Davis-Bacon, Certified Payroll, California DIR/DAS/eCPR, 
, ISNetworld, Avetta, Procore, Textura, or LCPTracker.



3. Compliance Scenario



A contractor license, insurance certificate, or GC prequalification is about to expire, and a project is scheduled to mobilize soon. What steps would you take to make sure the project is not delayed?



Please provide a specific example if you have handled a similar situation before.

title: Senior U.S. Human Resources Specialist – Part-Time, Remote
description:
About Utopia HR Solutions



Utopia HR Solutions is a growing U.S.-based human resources consulting firm providing customized HR support to small and midsize businesses across multiple industries and states.



Our services include HR audits, employee handbook development, policy creation, employee onboarding, compliance support, recruiting, performance management, and ongoing HR consulting.



We are seeking a highly experienced, detail-oriented HR professional to support the preparation and coordination of client HR deliverables.



This is not an entry-level virtual assistant position. We are looking for an experienced HR professional who understands U.S. HR practices, produces high-quality work, and can independently manage assigned projects while collaborating directly with the company's founder.



Key Responsibilities



- Prepare and draft employee handbooks, HR policies, procedures, and multistate addenda using established templates and instructions.

- Develop professional job descriptions, onboarding documents, employee acknowledgments, and HR forms.

- Assist with HR audits by reviewing documentation against established checklists, identifying missing information, and preparing findings for senior review.

- Research federal and state employment requirements using reliable government and regulatory sources.

- Prepare performance review templates, employee development documents, and other HR materials.

- Support recruiting activities, including resume screening, candidate tracking, and interview coordination.

- Organize client projects, maintain accurate documentation, and monitor deliverables and deadlines.

- Identify potential HR compliance concerns and escalate questions for review.

- Complete assigned work accurately, efficiently, and within agreed deadlines.



All client-facing compliance guidance and final HR deliverables are subject to review and approval by Utopia HR Solutions.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must have a minimum of six years of direct professional experience supporting U.S.-based human resources operations. This requirement is mandatory.



- At least 6 years of hands-on U.S. HR experience, including experience supporting American employers.

- Strong experience preparing U.S. employee handbooks, HR policies, job descriptions, and onboarding materials.

- Working knowledge of federal employment requirements, including FLSA, FMLA, ADA, and EEOC-related compliance.

- Experience supporting multistate U.S. employers.

- Familiarity with HR audits, personnel documentation, and compliance processes.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and document formatting.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple assignments.

- Ability to work independently, follow instructions, meet deadlines, and recognize when additional HR guidance is necessary.

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.



Preferred Qualifications



- Prior experience working for a U.S.-based HR consulting firm, PEO, or outsourced HR provider.

- Familiarity with employment requirements in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Florida, and other U.S. states.

- Experience using HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, ADP, Paychex, or Rippling.

- Experience supporting small and midsize businesses across multiple industries.

- SHRM or HRCI certification is a plus.



Schedule and Working Arrangement



This is a long-term, part-time remote opportunity beginning at approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential for additional hours as business needs grow.



The selected professional will work directly with the founder of Utopia HR Solutions. Scheduling is flexible, provided deadlines are met and the individual is available for mutually agreed meetings.



Other client engagements are permitted, subject to confidentiality and conflict-of-interest requirements.



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit:



1. Your updated resume highlighting your U.S. HR experience.

2. A brief summary explaining your experience supporting U.S.-based employers, including the number of years.

3. Examples of HR documents you have personally developed, such as employee handbooks, policies, or job descriptions. Please submit only nonconfidential or appropriately redacted materials.

4. Your experience with U.S. federal and multistate employment requirements.

5. Your desired hourly rate and weekly availability.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to participate in a video interview and a compensated practical HR assessment.



Please note: Candidates who do not have at least six years of direct U.S. HR experience will not be considered.



We are looking for a knowledgeable, dependable HR professional interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with a growing U.S. consulting firm.

title: Social Media Strategist & Content Lead for an Online Education Brand
description:
About Us



The Coaches Business Studio is an online learning platform designed to help coaches build, grow and develop successful coaching businesses.



We are creating a growing body of high-quality business education across areas such as positioning, personal brand, social media, finance, sales, associate coaching, corporate coaching, workshops, proposals and practice development.



One of the distinctive features of the Studio is our AI faculty. Each faculty member has their own area of expertise, personality and point of view, but the thinking, research, scripting and production behind the content is created by a real team.



We are currently building towards launch and already have a significant amount of video content in production.



We are now looking for someone to take ownership of the social media side of the business.



The Role



We are looking for someone who can think strategically about social media, work with us to shape the content plan, and then turn that thinking into an organised and consistent publishing operation.



You will work closely with the founder and our video production team.



We already have a clear overall social media strategy, including:



* different roles for YouTube, Instagram, 
 and

* clear content categories and editorial missions

* a strong distinction between free social content and paid learning inside the Studio

* a growing library of professionally produced video

* defined faculty characters and areas of expertise

* a clear brand direction



What we need is someone who can help turn that strategy into an intelligent, ongoing content system.



You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution.



One day you might be discussing whether an idea belongs on YouTube or LinkedIn.



The next, you might be writing the LinkedIn version of a video concept, briefing a carousel, preparing captions, building the publishing schedule, or d
 which short-form edit should be repurposed onto
.



You should be able to look at a piece of content and ask:



What is this trying to achieve? Who is it for? Which platform does it belong on? 

What is the strongest expression of the idea?



That kind of editorial judgement is central to the role.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will take responsibility for the planning and day-to-day management of the Studio’s social media presence across YouTube, Instagram, 
 and
.



The role will include:



* developing the ongoing social media plan in collaboration with the founder

* turning strategic themes into practical weekly and monthly content plans

* d
 which ideas belong on which platforms

* adapting ideas appropriately rather than simply reposting identical content everywhere

* writing captions, posts, hooks and supporting copy

* developing written LinkedIn content from broader Studio ideas

* identifying opportunities for Reels, Shorts, carousels, graphics and other social formats

* briefing the video production team on social-first creative requirements

* identifying useful edits and extracts from longer-form video

* conceptualising simple creative ideas that can be produced internally

* maintaining the publishing calendar

* scheduling and publishing content

* managing titles, descriptions, thumbnails, hashtags and platform metadata where relevant

* monitoring performance and identifying what is and is not working

* helping us gradually establish meaningful benchmarks for each platform

* bringing new ideas and recommendations rather than waiting to be told what to post



Over time, we would expect you to develop a strong understanding of the faculty, the Studio brand and the coaching-business market.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone with strong editorial judgement.



You do not need to be a coach, but you do need to be able to understand sophisticated professional content and turn it into social media that feels intelligent rather than generic.



You should have:



* strong social media strategy experience

* excellent written English

* strong copywriting and editing skills

* good visual judgement

* experience working across Instagram, YouTube, 
 and

* an understanding of how the same idea should be expressed differently on different platforms

* experience developing content calendars and editorial plans

* a good understanding of short-form video

* confidence working with long-form and short-form content together

* the ability to brief designers or video editors clearly

* the ability to distinguish between content that teaches, provokes, entertains, builds familiarity or creates desire

* confidence interpreting analytics without becoming obsessed with vanity metrics

* the ability to work independently and make decisions

* curiosity and willingness to challenge ideas when necessary



Experience with online education, coaching, professional services, creator-led businesses or membership brands would be useful, but is not essential.



What This Role Is Not



We are not looking for someone whose main skill is scheduling posts.



We are not looking for someone who relies heavily on generic content templates, motivational quotes or AI-generated filler.



We are not looking for someone who believes the answer to social media is simply “post more often”.



And we do not want identical content copied mechanically across every platform.

We care much more about strong ideas, good judgement and distinctive creative work.



How We Work



Our video team handles the core video production.



Your role would sit between strategy, editorial planning and distribution.



You would collaborate closely with the founder on ideas and direction, and with the production team on how those ideas are turned into finished creative assets.



We want someone who becomes part of the thinking behind the brand, rather than simply receiving a folder of finished videos and uploading them.



There is considerable scope to shape the role as the Studio grows.



To Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction explaining why this role interests you.

2. Examples of social media accounts or brands you have helped manage or grow.

3. Examples of content you personally conceptualised or wrote.

4. A brief explanation of how you would approach the same idea differently on:

    * YouTube

    * Instagram

    * LinkedIn

    *

5. An example of a social media brand you think does particularly good work, and why.



Please do not send a generic proposal. We are particularly interested in how you think.

title: Mechanical Engineer / Quantity Surveyor – Steelwork & Fabrication Designer | Remote
description:
Please follow the application instructions

Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines.

Applications that do not follow the requested format may not be considered.

title: An Experiential E-Commerce Website - Premium Tea, Spices
description:
The Project



We are Penbrae & Co Ltd, a Cardiff-based company importing rare, handcrafted teas, spices, and chillies from Northeast India. We are looking for a talented web designer to build our e-commerce website from scratch.



This is not a standard product catalogue. The website needs to tell the story of each product and the artisan producers who make them — through text, photography, short video, and audio — while making it completely easy to browse and buy on a phone.



What you’ll build:

• A fully functional WordPress + WooCommerce website (or equivalent — we’re open to ideas)

• Around 11 pages including three distinct product stalls, individual product pages, a maker stories section with an interactive map, a journal/blog, and a clean checkout

• Mobile-first, fast-loading, accessible, and beautifully designed

• A non-linear browsing experience — visitors should be able to move between products, makers, and stories without being funnelled through a single path



Draft site map

• Home — immersive landing, entry points to Stalls, Meet the Makers, and a featured product or story

• The Stalls → Teas / Spices / Chillies → individual Stalls will have a product catalogue (each product linked to product page)

• Product Page → Product Information (linked to its Story Page)

• Meet the Makers — interactive map → individual maker story pages (each linked to their Story Page, like a mind map)

• Story Page (of each product) — Story of the grower, pictures and videos of when, how and where it was made etc. (linked to its Product Page)

• About Penbrae — who we are, why we do this, Cardiff to Assam

• Subscribe — newsletter sign-up + optional tea/spice club

• Instagram feed woven into the website, not a standalone page



The look and feel is premium and editorial — think ancient, rare, limited edition. 



This project leads to ongoing work. We expect to grow the site over time and there is a realistic path from this fixed-price build to part-time and eventually full-time work for the right person.



Essential skills — WordPress/WooCommerce, strong visual design, mobile-first dev, AI-assisted coding (we expect you to use AI, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar, to accelerate your work; comfort with AI-assisted coding and problem-solving is essential, not optional), e-commerce UX, performance optimisation, SEO/analytics and creative problem solving



Bonus skills — graphic design, social media, photography/video editing, illustration or map-making (the last one is a quiet signal for the Maker Map).



To apply and move forward, please include in your response: 



1. Portfolio examples closest to this brief, with a short note on why you chose them

2. Tell us your preferred tech stack and roughly what you’d charge for a project of this scope. 

3. Your recommended tech stack, if different from WordPress + WooCommerce

4. A fixed-price quote for the full project, broken down by phase

5. Your hourly rate for part-time ongoing work after the build is complete — we expect to grow the engagement over time and want to understand what that looks like financially from the start

6. We are open to your approach (if you prefer Elementor, we can provide access to Astra Pro). If you have a better solution — a custom theme, a headless build, a different page builder — we want to hear your thinking.

title: Virtual Assistant – Business Development Associate – Real Estate—Immediate Start —Multiple Vacancies Available
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE - REFERRAL PARTNERSHIPS

Remote | Full-Time | Immediate Start



TYPE OF WORK

Full-time (UK business hours)



WAGE / SALARY

$300 per month fixed + $50-$100 for every referral that becomes a paying client (unlimited potential)



HOURS PER WEEK

40 hours, mostly UK business hours (approximately 9am-5pm UK, or 4pm-midnight Philippine time)



ABOUT US

We're a growing independent UK estate agency doing sales, lettings, property management and property maintenance. We're part of a global luxury real estate network and its exclusive lettings provider in the UK.



We have the brand and the back office. What we need now is a network of local partners who send us clients.



THE ROLE

Your job is to build and run our local referral partner network, reporting directly to the boss.



You will find tradespeople and local businesses, sign them up to a formal partnership where we pay them for sending us sales, lettings, management and maintenance clients, and then keep those partners active.



Tradespeople and local businesses spend their days in people's homes and talk to homeowners and landlords all the time. We want to be the first agent they think of.



WHO YOU WILL CONTACT

Builders, plumbers, electricians, roofers, decorators, locksmiths, cleaners, removal firms, gardeners and many other trades, plus businesses such as salons, solicitors, mortgage brokers and surveyors.



You will find them on Google Maps and other directories.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build lists of local businesses and trades in our target areas

- Contact them by phone, WhatsApp,
 and messaging, around 100 outreaches a day

- Explain the partnership and get them signed up

- Process the paperwork: send the partnership agreement, collect the signed copy and record everything in our CRM

- Keep a clear log of who has signed up, who is active and who has referred

- Follow up regularly with every partner: how business is going, whether they have met anyone who needs help, and how we can help them

- Send partners updates on the leads they have referred

- Identify the best partners and tell us who we should meet in person

- Come up with ideas to make the programme more attractive and more productive

- Send a weekly report: outreaches, sign-ups, active partners, referrals, results and what you would change



YOU MUST HAVE



- Clear, natural spoken English with a neutral accent, comfortable calling UK tradespeople

- Sales, business development, customer service or real estate experience

- Persistence in following up without being pushy

- Self-discipline to hit daily targets with little supervision

- Good written English and attention to detail with paperwork and records

- Reliable internet, a laptop or PC, and a quiet workspace

- Willingness to work UK business hours



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with a CRM

- Experience building referral or partner networks

- Property or construction industry experience

- Startup or small-team experience



PAY STRUCTURE

All payments are in USD, paid monthly by bank transfer.



FIXED BASE SALARY

$300 per month



HOW REFERRAL PAYMENTS WORK



- Referral payments apply to referrals from partners you recruit and manage, as recorded in our CRM, for 12 months from the date of each referral

- Referral payments are made once we have been paid

- Property sales: once the sale has completed

- Lettings: once the tenancy has started and the first rent has been received

- Maintenance: once the job has been completed and paid for

- No cap on referral earnings, so UNLIMITED EARNING POTENTIAL for high performers!





HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: Please
 your CV and an introduction video to 



 subject line: REFERRAL BDA



*Applications without the video will not be considered.*



WHAT TO COVER IN YOUR VIDEO



Please answer the following questions:



1. What is your experience in sales, business development or real estate?

2. How would you persuade a busy plumber or builder to sign up to a referral partnership with an agency they have never heard of?

3. How would you keep hundreds of partners engaged so they actually send referrals?

4. How do you keep up consistent daily outreach, and how would you track what is working?

5. What other ideas do you have for finding people who can send us property owners?

6. How soon can you start, and can you work UK business hours?

7. Please confirm you understand the pay: a fixed base plus a fixed payment for each referral that becomes a paying client, paid after we have been paid.



We look forward to working with you!

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.

title: Short-Form Video Editor: Entertainment Content (Long-Term)
description:
If you're tired of one-off gigs and clients who disappear after three videos, this this is for you. It's steady, ongoing work with the same clients every week.



We're a content agency. We work with entertainers and creators, we take their raw footage and turn it into short clips for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and
. We put out
clips a month across our roster.



You'll get your own set of clients and own their clips. Our editors stay with us long-term and their rosters grow over time.



ABOUT THE STYLE



You get full creative freedom. We don't have one house style you have to copy. We want our clients to look different from each other, not all cut from the same template. So you bring your own touch and adapt it to the clients you work with.



What isn't flexible: captions have to be accurate, timing has to be tight, and due dates get hit. Get those right and the creative side is yours.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit clips for your assigned clients: captions, graphics, hooks, cuts

- Develop a look that suits each client you work with

- Hit your weekly due dates

- Get clips right the first time. Rework costs you time and us the posting schedule

- Be available for two short calls and one team meeting a week, and daily communication on slack while working.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

- You can edit short-form social video (CapCut, Premiere etc) - We supply you with CapCut Pro

- Your English is strong enough to caption fast, casual US speech accurately, slang, accents and people talking over each other. This is the most important skill in the role

- You're detail-focused. Caption typos and timing slips matter more here than anything else

- You can work at volume without quality dropping

- You can commit to a consistent weekly schedule



EQUIPMENT

- You need a computer that handles video work, reliable internet, and storage space for raw footage. We send a lot of it and you'll be holding it while you work. An external hard drive is the normal setup, but plenty of free space on your computer works too.



PAY: Per approved clip:

- $2.00 for your first 50 clips

- $2.50 for the next 50

- $3.00 after that

Plus a $15/week base fee for availability: calls, team meetings, Slack, and going through training material.



Once you're up to speed with a full client roster, that works out to roughly $1,000/month plus the base. Our current editors are at that level.



HOW TO APPLY

- Put "CLIPMAKER" in your subject line.



Send:

- Your portfolio, or 2–3 short-form clips you've edited (links, not attachments)

- Your weekly availability in hours and your time zone

- Your storage setup, external drive size and free space, or free space on your computer



Shortlisted applicants get a short test: one raw set, one clip, cut to timestamps we provide. Every applicant gets the same footage so we can compare fairly.



Independent contractor, remote.

The Company is a growing, relationship-first real estate brokerage focused on helping agents build stronger and more sustainable businesses through leadership, coaching, marketing, technology, AI, systems, and community.



The Marketing Services Division provides done-for-you marketing and personal-brand support to help agents stay visible, build relationships, strengthen their brands, and generate new business opportunities.



## About the Role



The Head of Marketing & Agent Growth will lead the Company’s overall marketing strategy, support agents with their individual marketing needs, and drive the growth of the Marketing Services Division.



This is a strategic, relationship-driven, and revenue-focused role — not primarily a graphic design or production position.



The person in this role will work directly with agents to understand their businesses, identify marketing opportunities, recommend solutions, introduce appropriate marketing services, guide agents through the sales process, and oversee onboarding and fulfillment coordination.



## Key Responsibilities



### Marketing Strategy & Brand Leadership



* Develop and manage the Company’s overall marketing strategy.

* Create marketing plans that support recruiting, agent retention, training, company growth, culture, and brand awareness.

* Strengthen the Company’s positioning, messaging, and brand voice.

* Turn company goals into campaigns, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead campaign strategy, messaging, copywriting, and creative direction.

* Maintain marketing, content, training, and event calendars.

* Review campaign performance and recommend improvements.

* Ensure consistent branding across websites, email, social media, community platforms, YouTube, presentations, and agent communications.



### Agent Marketing & Relationship Management



* Serve as the primary marketing point of contact for agents.

* Build relationships through calls, meetings, trainings, events, and proactive outreach.

* Proactively reach out to agents instead of waiting for marketing requests.

* Understand each agent’s business, goals, challenges, market, budget, and marketing activity.

* Conduct marketing consultations, brand audits, website reviews, and strategy sessions.

* Identify gaps in branding, websites, social media, databases, content, and follow-up systems.

* Recommend practical marketing priorities based on each agent’s goals and resources.

* Help agents improve their personal brand, content, email marketing, websites, social media, and database marketing.

* Follow up after consultations and help agents take action.

* Share recurring agent feedback and needs with leadership.



### Marketing Services Sales & Growth



* Lead the growth strategy for the Marketing Services Division.

* Understand all available services, pricing, deliverables, timelines, and processes.

* Introduce agents to marketing services through consultations, email, trainings, webinars, events, and direct outreach.

* Conduct discovery calls to understand agent needs.

* Recommend services based on the agent’s goals, budget, and marketing needs.

* Clearly explain services, pricing, timelines, responsibilities, and expectations.

* Confidently ask for the business when there is a strong fit.

* Follow up with prospects and move opportunities through the sales process.

* Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, proposals, enrollments, active clients, renewals, and cancellations.

* Identify upsell and expansion opportunities with existing clients.

* Track leads, conversions, revenue, retention, and cancellations.



### Client Onboarding



* Own the onboarding experience for new marketing services clients.

* Welcome new clients and explain next steps.

* Confirm agreements, payments, services, timelines, responsibilities, and communication expectations.

* Collect required information, files, brand assets, and account access.

* Set up projects, tasks, deadlines, owners, and workflows in 
.

* Coordinate kickoff meetings and handoffs to the fulfillment team.

* Monitor the first stages of service delivery.

* Check in with clients during their first 30 days.

* Address onboarding concerns and coordinate solutions.

* Maintain organized client records and improve onboarding systems when needed.



### New Agent Marketing Onboarding



* Participate in the onboarding of newly affiliated agents.

* Introduce agents to available marketing tools, resources, trainings, templates, and support.

* Explain what is included with the brokerage and what is available separately through marketing services.

* Conduct an initial marketing assessment for each new agent.

* Identify the top marketing priorities they should focus on first.

* Coordinate agent bios, headshots, profiles, websites, welcome campaigns, and announcements when needed.

* Follow up after onboarding to encourage adoption and identify additional needs.



### Content, Messaging & Storytelling



* Lead messaging and content strategy for major company initiatives.

* Develop copy and messaging for recruiting, training, agent recognition, culture, announcements, and marketing services.

* Turn leadership ideas into campaigns, emails, scripts, website copy, presentations, and marketing briefs.

* Develop agent stories, success stories, and recognition content.

* Maintain a consistent, clear, personal, and human brand voice.



### Training & Event Marketing



* Lead marketing for trainings, webinars, workshops, meetings, and company events.

* Manage the training and event marketing calendar.

* Develop promotional messaging, registration campaigns, reminders, and follow-up communication.

* Coordinate graphics, presentations, landing pages, emails, social posts, and other event materials.

* Track registrations, attendance, participation, and feedback.



### Websites & Digital Platforms



* Oversee website strategy, structure, messaging, and content.

* Coordinate website updates, landing pages, agent pages, recruiting pages, and service pages.

* Maintain accurate information about services, pricing, processes, testimonials, FAQs, and calls to action.

* Improve website user experience and lead-generation opportunities.

* Coordinate advanced development or integrations with appropriate specialists.

* Ensure website leads are captured, tracked, and followed up.



### Community, YouTube & Agent Communication



* Manage the strategy and organization of the Company’s online agent community.

* Determine which trainings, resources, announcements, stories, and updates should be shared.

* Encourage agent participation through useful content and personal outreach.

* Oversee the Company’s YouTube content strategy.

* Coordinate video editing, thumbnails, uploads, titles, descriptions, and publishing with the production team.

* Coordinate messaging across email, community platforms, social media, meetings, and other channels.



### Marketing Operations & Project Management



* Build and manage marketing workflows in 
.

* Coordinate marketing projects from request through completion.

* Ensure every project has a clear owner, deadline, purpose, status, and next step.

* Coordinate designers, editors, website specialists, virtual assistants, contractors, and vendors.

* Manage revisions, approvals, missing information, and project communication.

* Build repeatable systems for campaigns, onboarding, trainings, websites, and recurring marketing activities.

* Document processes so work can be delegated and scaled.

* Monitor team capacity and identify bottlenecks.

* Maintain quality standards without becoming the main production person.



### Agent Engagement & Retention



* Create initiatives that help agents feel recognized, supported, and connected.

* Develop welcome campaigns, milestone recognition, anniversaries, success stories, and community highlights.

* Identify disengaged agents and coordinate thoughtful outreach.

* Gather feedback about marketing support, trainings, communication, and services.

* Recommend improvements that increase agent satisfaction, participation, productivity, and retention.



## Role Boundaries



The Head of Marketing & Agent Growth is responsible for strategy, relationships, sales, onboarding, coordination, and quality — not being the Company’s primary production person.



### This Role Owns



* Marketing strategy and brand direction.

* Agent marketing relationships and consultations.

* Agent outreach and marketing assessments.

* Marketing services discovery and sales conversations.

* Sales pipeline management and growth.

* Client onboarding.

* New-agent marketing onboarding.

* Campaign planning and creative direction.

* Copywriting and messaging.

* Training and event marketing.

* Website strategy and messaging.

* Marketing systems and workflows.

* Project coordination and team direction.

* Quality control and reporting.



### This Role May Coordinate but Does Not Need to Personally Execute



* High-volume graphic design.

* Logo design.

* Daily Canva production.

* Video editing and animation.

* Advanced website development.

* Daily social media posting.

* Photography and videography.

* Large-scale content repurposing.

* Routine client fulfillment.

* Technical integrations.

* Repetitive administrative production.



The goal is to hire a marketing and growth leader — not a production coordinator handling every flyer, website edit, or social media request.



## Required Qualifications



* 5+ years of experience in marketing, account management, business development, consultative sales, real estate, or a related field.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience developing marketing strategies, campaigns, messaging, and content.

* Strong relationship-building and client-facing experience.

* Experience conducting discovery calls, consultations, assessments, or sales conversations.

* Comfortable proactively reaching out to agents and asking for the business when appropriate.

* Strong project management and organizational skills.

* Experience managing multiple projects, clients, stakeholders, team members, or contractors.

* Strong copywriting, storytelling, editing, and messaging skills.

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

* Ability to work independently and follow through without constant supervision.

* Comfortable balancing relationship-building with revenue and performance expectations.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving remote environment.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in real estate, a brokerage, real estate team, marketing agency, coaching company, or membership organization.

* Knowledge of real estate agent marketing, personal branding, recruiting, retention, database marketing, and lead generation.

* Experience selling marketing, branding, website, consulting, or content services.

* Experience onboarding clients into recurring service packages.

* Familiarity with Lofty, Squarespace, 
, Circle, Canva, CRM systems, email marketing platforms, and social media tools.

* Experience managing virtual assistants, designers, developers, editors, contractors, or creative teams.

* Basic website management experience.

* Experience tracking marketing, sales, engagement, retention, and revenue metrics.

* Experience using AI for research, writing, planning, content development, analysis, or workflow improvement.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is strategic, proactive, relationship-driven, and commercially aware.



They can develop a company-wide marketing strategy while also speaking directly with an individual agent about their business and marketing needs.



They proactively reach out, identify opportunities, recommend solutions, follow up, and ensure commitments are completed.



They are comfortable conducting consultations, recommending services, asking for the sale, onboarding clients, and coordinating a fulfillment team.



They understand that marketing is not simply creating graphics or posting content. Marketing should strengthen relationships, communicate value, generate opportunities, and support measurable business outcomes.



## Key Performance Measures



* Agent conversations and marketing consultations.

* Consultation follow-up completion.

* New-agent marketing onboarding completion.

* Agent satisfaction and engagement.

* Marketing services discovery calls and proposals.

* Discovery-to-enrollment conversion rate.

* New recurring and one-time revenue.

* Active clients, retention, renewals, and cancellations.

* Client onboarding completion and first-30-day experience.

* Marketing campaign performance.

* Training registrations and attendance.

* Email, website, and community engagement.

* On-time project completion.

* Quality and organization of marketing workflows.

* Development of repeatable marketing systems.



## First 90 Days



### First 30 Days — Learn & Audit



* Learn the Company’s business model, brand, agents, systems, services, and culture.

* Meet with leadership, operations, recruiting, brokerage, marketing team members, and agents.

* Review current websites, campaigns, emails, social media, community platforms, YouTube, and marketing workflows.

* Learn all marketing services, pricing, processes, and fulfillment standards.

* Review the sales pipeline, active clients, onboarding process, and fulfillment workflows.

* Identify immediate marketing, sales, onboarding, communication, and operational gaps.

* Establish baseline performance metrics.



### Days 31–60 — Build the Foundation



* Establish a consistent agent outreach and consultation process.

* Create a repeatable marketing audit and recommendation process.

* Improve the marketing services sales pipeline and tracking system.

* Document client onboarding and handoff processes.

* Establish marketing, content, training, and communication calendars.

* Improve how marketing resources and services are introduced to agents.

* Begin consistent proactive agent outreach.

* Identify priority campaigns for recruiting, retention, training, culture, and revenue growth.



### Days 61–90 — Launch & Improve



* Present and execute a prioritized quarterly marketing plan.

* Launch priority marketing and growth campaigns.

* Begin reporting marketing, sales, agent engagement, and revenue metrics.

* Recommend improvements to services, positioning, onboarding, fulfillment, and client experience.

* Establish a consistent reporting process.

* Clarify responsibilities across strategy, sales, onboarding, project management, and production.

* Identify additional staffing, contractor, system, or training needs.

* Provide leadership with a clear assessment of what is working, what needs improvement, and recommended next steps.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR — ECOMMERCE META ADS

Remote | Full-time | $900–$1,500 USD depending on experience



ABOUT MHI MEDIA



MHI Media is a performance marketing agency helping ambitious e-commerce and DTC brands grow. We create and test the ads that drive sales for brands operating at serious scale.



Our creative team is made up of editors, designers, strategists and pod leads working together across a large portfolio of brands. We produce a high volume of creative, learn from performance data and improve quickly — so this is a great environment for someone who wants to become genuinely excellent at advertising, not just make videos that look nice.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-quality Video Editor who understands that a paid social ad has one job: earn attention, communicate the idea clearly and move the viewer towards action.



You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

- Repurpose winning concepts into new hooks, edits, lengths, placements and aspect ratios

- Communicate early when a brief, asset or deadline is unclear or blocked

- Study performance feedback and use it to make future creative stronger



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



- Your first version is already clean, considered and close to the brief

- You understand why a hook, cut, pause, caption or visual is being used — not just how to add it

- You catch spelling, pacing, safe-zone, branding, continuity and audio issues before submitting

- You can take direct feedback without becoming defensive and implement it properly

- You are reliable: deadlines are met, blockers are raised early and tasks do not disappear

- Your work gets better as you learn what performs for different audiences and brands

- Strategists and pod leads trust you with increasingly important work



WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.



You will probably do well here if you are:



- Performance-minded: interested in what makes people stop, watch and buy

- Detail-obsessed: you notice the one typo, wrong product, weak cut or incorrect logo before anyone else does

- A strong brief reader: you follow direction precisely and ask questions when something is unclear

- Coachable: you actively want detailed feedback and use it to improve

- Proactive: you look for the next useful action instead of waiting to be chased

- Fast but not careless: you can work at volume without lowering your standards

- Commercially curious: you want to understand the customer, offer, audience and creative strategy behind the edit

- A clear communicator: you can explain your decisions and flag problems early

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and shared deadlines



This probably will not be the right role for you if you only want to make cinematic edits, dislike performance-driven work, ignore briefs, take feedback personally or need constant supervision.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing e-commerce, direct-response, paid social, UGC or comparable advertising work

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut or a similar professional editing tool

- Working knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, music and basic colour correction

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and vertical video formats

- Professional written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection and availability for full-time remote work

- Ability to work within a structured workflow and meet deadlines consistently



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience editing Meta ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience working from performance data or iterating ads based on results

- After Effects, Photoshop, Figma or graphic-design ability

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Runway, Descript or similar

- Familiarity with Airtable, 
, Slack or comparable production tools

- Experience creating multiple hooks or variations from one core concept



WHAT WE OFFER



- Fully remote, long-term work with a growing international team

- Monthly compensation in USD, with the range based on experience and demonstrated ability

- Exposure to real e-commerce brands and creative that runs in live ad accounts

- The chance to see what actually performs, rather than editing in a results vacuum

- Direct, useful feedback from experienced pod leads and creative strategists

- A clear path to grow into a senior editor, specialist editor or pod-lead position

- Opportunity to work across different products, audiences and creative formats

- A team that values initiative, improvement and high standards
