About us:

PARFUMOIR is a fast-growing perfume brand from the Netherlands. We send weekly
 campaigns and automated
 flows. Strategy, copywriting and building the
s are done in-house. We are looking for a talented designer who turns our clear, written briefs into beautiful, premium
 images.



What you will do:

- Design
 images (hero banners, offer blocks, product sections, buttons, review blocks) based on detailed briefs.

About 2
s per week, each with 4–7 image blocks.

- Create product scenes: place our perfume bottle in styled settings (mock-ups, photo compositing, AI image tools).

- Work from briefs in Notion and deliver files in Google Drive with fixed file names.

- Process feedback quickly (usually one revision round).

- Over time: build a reusable library of on-brand
 blocks.



Requirements:

- A strong portfolio of e-commerce
 designs (DTC brands; beauty, fashion or luxury is a big plus). Please share links. No portfolio means no consideration.

- An excellent eye for premium, minimal design: white space, typography, product photography.

- Expert in Figma, canva and/or Photoshop, with experience in product mock-ups and photo compositing.

- Experience with AI image tools (e.g. chatgpt, Higgsfield) is a plus.

- You understand
 design: 600 px layouts, small file sizes, readable on mobile.

- Good written English, and you follow briefs exactly. Our briefs are in English, but the text in the designs is Dutch. You copy-paste it from the brief, and an English translation is always included.

- Reliable: you deliver within 48 hours of receiving a brief.



Details:

- Part-time, flexible hours, long-term.

- Pay: €8 per hour, paid weekly.

- Start: as soon as possible.



How to apply

Send us:

- Links to 3–5
 designs you made (Figma, Behance, Dribbble or images).

- One sentence on which brand’s
s you think are the best designed, and why.

- Your availability (hours per week).



Start your message with the word “BOTTLE” so we know you read the full post.

title: AI, Marketing & Automation Project Manager – Full-Time Remote
description:
AI, MARKETING & AUTOMATION PROJECT MANAGER – FULL-TIME REMOTE



Must be excellent at GHL, landing pages, AI tools, canva

Salary: $4 USD/hour  

Hours: 40 hours per week  

Location: Remote – Philippines  

Long-term position with opportunity for salary growth



We are a growing digital marketing agency looking for a highly organised, tech-focused AI, Marketing & Automation Project Manager to join our team full-time.



This is not a traditional social media manager role.



We are looking for someone who is excited about AI, automation and finding faster and better ways of working. You will help manage our client workload while also improving the systems behind the agency.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



AI & CONTENT CREATION



• Use Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to create high-quality social media content  

• Create graphics and marketing materials using Canva  

• Turn client information into monthly content plans  

• Use AI to speed up research, copywriting and content production  

• Stay up to date with new AI tools that could improve our services  



AUTOMATION & SYSTEMS



• Help build and improve our internal CRM and workflows  

• Build and maintain systems in ClickUp  

• Help automate repetitive tasks across the agency  

• Work with GoHighLevel and other automation tools  

• Identify areas where AI or automation could save the team time  

• Make sure tasks, deadlines and client deliverables do not get missed  



PROJECT MANAGEMENT



• Keep client projects organised and on schedule  

• Assign and track tasks across the team  

• Follow up on outstanding work  

• Maintain our ClickUp workspace  

• Ensure monthly client deliverables are completed on time  

• Help keep the agency organised as we continue to grow  



MARKETING



• Social media content creation and scheduling  

• Basic video editing for Reels and TikTok  

• Understanding of Meta and Google Ads is preferred  



Ads will not be the main part of this role. You do not need to be an expert media buyer, but you should understand the basics of digital advertising.



WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:



• Is very comfortable using AI tools  

• Has experience with ChatGPT and/or Claude  

• Has experience with ClickUp or similar project management software  

• Understands automation and CRMs  

• Can create professional social media content  

• Has basic video editing skills  

• Is extremely organised  

• Can manage multiple clients and deadlines  

• Is proactive and does not need to be constantly reminded of tasks  

• Enjoys learning new technology  

• Looks for ways to improve systems rather than simply following instructions  

• Has strong written English  

• Is reliable and looking for a long-term role  



Experience with GoHighLevel, Make, Zapier, Canva, Meta Ads or Google Ads is a major advantage.



SALARY & GROWTH



Starting salary is $4 USD per hour for 40 hours per week.



We are looking for someone long-term, and there will be opportunities for salary increases based on performance, responsibility and the value you bring to the agency.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the words “AI PROJECT MANAGER” so we know you read the full job description.

2. Tell us which AI tools you currently use and what you use them for.

3. Give one example of something you have automated or systemised.

4. Tell us about your experience with ClickUp and/or GoHighLevel.

5. Send an example of social media content you have created.

6. Tell us what you would automate first if you joined a digital marketing agency managing 15+ clients.

7. Include your internet speed and computer specifications.



Important: Please do not contact us through WhatsApp, phone, social media or any platform outside OnlineJobs.ph regarding this position. Applicants who do so will not be considered.



We are particularly interested in people who are curious, resourceful and genuinely interested in AI. You do not need to know every tool already, but you should be someone who enjoys figuring things out and continuously finding better ways to work.

title: WE’RE HIRING: FULL-TIME GRAPHIC DESIGNER
description:

title: Creative Video Editor | Paid Social Ads | Full-Time | $500/month
description:
We're Nosu, a growing Dutch health & wellness e-commerce brand looking for a talented, fast, and creative video editor.



We create UGC, founder-led ads, street interviews, mashups, and occasionally longer-form sales videos.



We're looking for an editor who understands storytelling, pacing, and when to use effects — not someone who adds effects everywhere.



What you'll do



- Edit approximately **1 video per working day** (typically 60–90 seconds).

- Create engaging pacing while preserving the story.

- Add purposeful motion graphics, VFX, SFX, and transitions.

- Find and integrate fitting B-roll (existing footage, stock, online sources, or AI-generated).

- Identify which moments deserve emphasis and which should remain simple.

- Create iterations and variations of existing ads.

- Deliver organized, editable projects, final exports, and reusable assets.



Minimal color grading required.



Requirements



- Excellent pacing, storytelling, and creative judgment.

- Experience editing social media advertisements, preferably DTC/UGC.

- Ability to work independently and make creative decisions.

- Strong motion graphics, VFX, and sound design skills.

- Fast turnaround and reliable communication.

- Ability to understand Dutch-language footage using transcription/translation tools. You must understand the message before editing.

- Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects preferred, but results matter most.



Position



- Salary: $500 USD/month

- Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week

- Schedule: Flexible

- Location: Remote

- Goal: Long-term collaboration



How to apply



Please include:



1. Portfolio: Three examples of ads you've personally edited.



2. Creative judgment: Choose one portfolio video and briefly explain which moments you emphasized, why, and where you deliberately avoided adding effects.



3. Dutch workflow: Explain how you'd edit a 90-second Dutch-language video without speaking Dutch, while preserving the story and identifying moments to emphasize.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid editing trial.

title: Senior 3D Exhibition & Event Designer

title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT (VA)
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | US-Based Company



ABOUT OUR COMPANY



We are a growing US-based business focused on delivering high-quality service, maintaining efficient operations, and building long-term customer relationships. As our business continues to expand, we are looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and results-driven Virtual Assistant to support our daily operations and help us operate more efficiently.



We are seeking a professional who understands the importance of accuracy, communication, accountability, and consistent execution. The right candidate will play an important role in keeping our operations organized, ensuring tasks are completed on time, maintaining accurate business records, and helping our team stay focused on its priorities.



This position is for someone who takes ownership, anticipates problems, follows through on commitments, and looks for solutions instead of waiting for constant direction.



We value people who take their work seriously, communicate proactively, learn quickly, and consistently deliver quality results. We are looking for a dependable professional who wants to build a long-term working relationship and grow alongside our business.



POSITION OVERVIEW



As our Virtual Assistant, you will provide administrative, operational, research, and digital support across various business activities. You will work with our team to manage information, coordinate tasks, maintain documentation, monitor deadlines, and ensure that important details do not get overlooked.



This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote working environment.



We are not simply looking for someone to complete a checklist of tasks. We want a proactive team member who can help improve processes, identify inefficiencies, and make our day-to-day operations more organized and productive.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Administrative & Executive Support

Manage business
s, digital documents, spreadsheets, and internal records.

Organize calendars, appointments, meetings, reminders, and task schedules.

Prepare professional documents, reports, summaries, and other administrative materials.

Maintain structured digital filing systems and ensure documents are properly organized.

Monitor pending tasks and follow up to ensure timely completion.

Assist with recurring administrative processes and special projects as assigned.

Keep important information organized, accessible, and up to date.

Handle sensitive business information with professionalism and confidentiality.

2. Business Operations & Workflow Management

Support daily business operations by keeping tasks, priorities, and deadlines organized.

Maintain task trackers and provide clear updates on progress, outstanding items, and potential delays.

Coordinate with team members to ensure responsibilities are understood and completed.

Identify bottlenecks, missing information, and operational issues that require attention.

Follow established procedures while suggesting practical improvements when appropriate.

Help document repeatable processes, checklists, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Ensure assigned tasks are completed accurately and within agreed timelines.

Escalate urgent issues promptly rather than allowing problems to remain unresolved.

3. Data Management & Documentation

Enter, update, review, and verify information in spreadsheets, databases, and CRM systems.

Maintain accurate business records and ensure information is complete and consistent.

Conduct quality checks to identify duplicate entries, missing information, and data errors.

Organize customer information, business contacts, reports, and digital documentation.

Compile information from multiple sources into clear, organized spreadsheets or summaries.

Maintain accurate records of task status, communications, and completed work.

Follow appropriate procedures when handling confidential customer and business data.

4.
, Communication & Follow-Up

Draft clear, professional
s and business communications.

Monitor assigned inboxes and organize incoming requests by priority.

Follow up on outstanding tasks, unanswered messages, and pending information.

Communicate professionally with team members, customers, vendors, and business contacts when required.

Provide timely updates without waiting to be asked.

Ask relevant questions when instructions are unclear and communicate potential problems early.

Maintain professional communication standards across all assigned channels.

5. Online Research & Problem-Solving

Conduct online research to gather accurate and relevant business information.

Compare information from multiple sources and summarize findings.

Prepare organized research documents, lists, and reports.

Verify important details before entering information into company records.

Identify practical solutions to routine operational and administrative challenges.

Use sound judgment to distinguish between tasks that can be handled independently and issues requiring approval.

6. AI Tools, Technology & Productivity

Use ChatGPT and other appropriate AI tools to support research, writing, summarization, and administrative workflows.

Work efficiently with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and online business platforms.

Learn new software, CRM systems, project management tools, and internal processes quickly.

Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work through templates, automation, and improved workflows.

Review AI-generated content and verify important information before using it.

Maintain accuracy, confidentiality, and professional standards when using AI tools.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



We believe strong performance comes from consistency, accountability, and attention to detail. The successful candidate will be expected to:



Take ownership: Accept responsibility for assigned tasks and follow them through to completion.

Meet deadlines: Manage priorities effectively and deliver work within agreed timeframes.

Maintain accuracy: Review work carefully and minimize preventable errors.

Communicate proactively: Provide timely updates and raise issues before they become larger problems.

Stay organized: Keep records, files, task lists, and communications structured and current.

Solve problems: Look for practical solutions instead of repeatedly waiting for instructions.

Protect confidentiality: Handle customer and business information responsibly.

Improve continuously: Learn from feedback, adapt to new processes, and identify ways to work more efficiently.



We value measurable progress, dependable execution, and professional communication. Quality and reliability matter just as much as speed.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent organizational, analytical, and time-management abilities.

High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

Proficiency in Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Drive.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word.

Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT and AI-assisted productivity applications.

Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and prioritize competing deadlines.

Strong internet research, documentation, and data management skills.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Professional judgment, integrity, accountability, and a solution-oriented mindset.

Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer for daily work.

Preferred Experience

Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Executive Assistant, or Operations Assistant.

Experience working with US-based businesses or international clients.

Familiarity with CRM systems and project management platforms.

Experience creating SOPs, maintaining task trackers, or improving administrative workflows.

Experience using AI tools to improve productivity.

Experience in construction, home services, real estate, or other service-based industries is an advantage.

EMPLOYMENT DETAILS & WORK SCHEDULE

Position: Virtual Assistant – Business Operations & Administrative Support

Employment Type: Full-Time

Commitment: Long-Term

Work Arrangement: Remote

Working Days: Monday through Friday

Working Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT)

Time Zone: US Pacific Time, observing daylight saving time when applicable.



Applicants must be available to work the full required schedule consistently. Please consider the time difference in your location before applying.



WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?



We are building a business with long-term goals, and we want to work with professionals who take pride in their contributions.



Become part of a growing business where reliable operational support makes a real difference.

Develop valuable skills in administration, business operations, technology, and process management.

Work with modern digital tools and AI-assisted workflows.

Take responsibility for meaningful work and contribute ideas for improvement.

Build a long-term professional relationship with a team that values consistency and accountability.

Have the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as the business grows, depending on performance and business needs.



We appreciate people who are dependable, receptive to feedback, committed to learning, and serious about delivering quality work.



Our goal is to build a professional working relationship based on trust, clear communication, consistent performance, and mutual growth.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To help us evaluate your experience and suitability for this position, please include:



Professional Introduction: Briefly introduce yourself and explain your relevant experience.

Work Experience: Describe your previous administrative, virtual assistance, or business operations responsibilities.

Technical Skills: List the software, CRM systems, spreadsheet tools, and AI applications you use confidently.

Organization & Accountability: Explain how you track deadlines, manage multiple tasks, and ensure follow-ups are completed.

Problem-Solving: Share an example of a problem you identified and resolved independently.

Availability: Confirm that you can work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time.

Portfolio or Work Samples: If available, provide examples of spreadsheets, reports, documentation, or workflows you have created. Please do not share confidential information belonging to previous employers.

Practical Application Questions



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Question 1: You have 10 pending tasks, three urgent
s, and a deadline approaching. How would you prioritize your work and keep the team informed?



Question 2: You discover incorrect or missing information in an important business spreadsheet. What steps would you take to verify and correct it?



Question 3: Which AI tools do you currently use, and how would you use them to improve administrative efficiency without compromising accuracy or confidentiality?



Applications that address these questions thoughtfully and specifically will help us better understand your working style and problem-solving abilities.



FINAL NOTE



We are looking for a professional who is organized, dependable, resourceful, and committed to doing excellent work. The ideal candidate takes initiative, communicates clearly, respects deadlines, and understands that consistent execution is essential to a growing business.



If you are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can apply your skills, take ownership of your responsibilities, and contribute to meaningful business growth, we encourage you to apply.



We look forward to finding the right professional to join our team and grow with us.

title: Virtual Assistant (US Optometry or Ophthalmology Experience)
description:
We are a U.S. based placement company. Through our specialized virtual assistant program, we train Philippine-based virtual assistants and match each one with an optometry or ophthalmology practice in the United States. This post is for virtual assistants who have already supported a U.S. eye care practice and want a long term placement with one practice, working from home as their dedicated assistant.



HOW THIS WORKS

We are the placement company, not the practice itself. If you pass screening and interviews, you complete our free eye care training (60+ hours) and earn our Virtual Assistant Certificate. We then match you with one U.S. practice. Placement depends on practice demand, so we cannot promise a start date. Paid hours begin on your first day with the practice, at $7.00 USD per hour, paid per tracked hour. You work as an independent contractor and register with the BIR once you qualify, using your own computer and internet connection. There are no application fees, placement fees or training costs at any stage.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

You support one U.S. eye care practice in one of three roles, matched to your experience.



VIRTUAL RECEPTIONIST



Answering patient calls,
s and messages

Scheduling, confirming and rescheduling appointments

Patient recalls and answering questions about eye care services



ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT



Verifying vision and medical insurance and gathering patient information

Updating patient chart records

Fax and file management, orders and other back office tasks



VIRTUAL SCRIBE



Live scribing during patient exams

Accurate, confidential chart documentation in the practice's EHR



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Once placed: full time hours at $7.00 USD per hour, on U.S. clinic hours (night shift in the Philippines)

A long term placement with one U.S. practice, rather than rotating between clients

Free specialized eye care training, with no fees at any stage

Fully remote work from your own home



REQUIREMENTS



Experience as a virtual assistant for a U.S. optometry or ophthalmology practice

Bachelor's degree, with proof of education

Philippine citizen, residing in the Philippines

Excellent spoken and written English

Strong computer skills and the ability to multitask across systems

A reliable computer, stable internet and a quiet home workspace

Available full time for U.S. business hours, which are night shifts in the Philippines

title: Static Ad Creative Designer (AI Workflow: ChatGPT + Higgsfield)
description:
Static Ad Creative Designer (AI Workflow: ChatGPT + Higgsfield)

Remote | Freelance | Ongoing | Growth path to Creative Strategist



About us

We are an Amsterdam based e-commerce company running multiple DTC brands in personal care and health accessories, selling mainly through Meta ads across Europe. We test new creatives every week and we are looking for someone who can turn strategy into winning statics.



The role

You will produce static ad creatives for our brands. The creative strategy comes from us: we define the angles, hooks, audiences and offers. You’ll be guided by us directly and receive creative strategy directions from us, and you turn those briefs into high converting statics, ready to launch.



But we don’t want someone who only follows briefs. Next to executing our strategy, we expect you to do your own research: study competitors, ad libraries, customer reviews and trends, and come to us with angles and ideas of your own.



What matters to us

Hit rate over volume. We’d rather have 5 statics with one winner than 50 that go nowhere. Every static you deliver should be made to win.



What you’ll do



Turn creative briefs into statics with a clear angle and a reason to convert

Do your own research and pitch new angles, hooks and concepts

Generate and edit product visuals and lifestyle imagery with Higgsfield

Use ChatGPT for copy variations, headlines and image generation where it fits

Deliver in all required Meta formats (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) with clean, on brand layouts

Analyse performance with us and iterate: turn losers into winners, and winners into stronger variations

Hit agreed deadlines



What we’re looking for



A proven track record: preferably at least 10 winning statics, each with $10k+ in ad spend while maintaining the client’s KPIs

Hands on experience with both Higgsfield and ChatGPT in your daily workflow

Strong understanding of direct response: hooks, benefit callouts, social proof, before/after, us vs them, offer driven layouts

An analytical mind: you know why an ad wins or loses, not just that it did

Comfortable taking direction and receiving feedback

Good written English; Dutch, Polish or French is a plus (we sell in those markets)



Compensation

A base fee plus a share in the results. For every winning ad (meeting KPIs agreed with us upfront) you earn a 5% commission on the ad spend behind that ad.



Growth path

This role can grow into Creative Strategist, with a higher base and a higher commission scheme. That step is for someone who consistently delivers winners and shows strong strategic thinking through their own research and ideas.



How to apply

Send us:



Your portfolio with your best winning statics, including for each: brand, niche, ad spend and results (ROAS, CPA or CTR). Ads Manager screenshots are required

Your hit rate: roughly how many of the statics you make become winners

Your breakdown method: explain how you analyse winning and losing ads. What do you look at, and how do you d
 what to change?

Your losers: show 2 or 3 statics that lost, explain why they lost, and show the iteration you made that turned it into a winner, with the results

A short description of your workflow with ChatGPT and Higgsfield

title: Experienced Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator
description:
Company: GLS Group

Location: Philippines (Cebu preferred, applications welcome nationwide)

Employment: Full-time, long-term

Work Arrangement: Remote, with potential to transition to an office-based team

Reporting to: GLS Group Directors



About GLS Group



GLS Group is an international legal services business operating across Singapore, Dubai and other international markets.



We provide legal services to businesses through an innovative operating model, combining experienced lawyers, technology and efficient business processes.



Our businesses include legal operations consulting, managed legal services and innovative legal support solutions for startups and growing businesses.



We are expanding our international operations and establishing a dedicated Philippines-based support team.



The Opportunity



We are looking for an experienced, capable and highly organised Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator to take responsibility for the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration of our four business entities.



We use Xero as our accounting platform, and practical experience with Xero is essential.



This is a hands-on position requiring someone who can independently manage the full range of bookkeeping responsibilities expected in a small international business.



You will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing invoicing and receivables, reconciling transactions, preparing monthly financial reports and working with our external accountants.



We want someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, identifies discrepancies, follows up on outstanding matters and ensures our financial records are consistently accurate and up to date.



Our objective is to have a well-managed bookkeeping function that operates reliably without requiring constant supervision from our Directors.



The position will also include general business administration and support for our growing marketing operations.



As we establish our Philippines-based support team, you will assist with marketing database maintenance, data entry and related administrative activities.



This will provide an opportunity to become familiar with our businesses, systems and operations while contributing to the development of our support team.



Key Responsibilities



1. Bookkeeping & Financial Records



Maintain accurate and complete bookkeeping records for four separate business entities.

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping activities using Xero.

Record and categorise income, expenses and financial transactions.

Maintain accurate general ledgers and supporting financial records.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and payment transactions.

Identify and investigate discrepancies, missing transactions and incorrect allocations.

Maintain appropriate supporting documentation for all financial transactions.

Ensure financial records are complete, properly organised and available for review.

Maintain accurate intercompany transaction records and reconciliations.

Assist with month-end and year-end bookkeeping procedures.



2. Client Invoicing & Accounts Receivable



Prepare, generate and issue client invoices using Xero.

Ensure invoices are accurate, properly authorised and issued promptly.

Maintain accurate client billing records.

Record and allocate customer payments against outstanding invoices.

Monitor accounts receivable and overdue invoices.

Prepare regular aged receivables reports.

Follow up professionally on overdue payments.

Investigate discrepancies between invoices, receipts and customer accounts.

Maintain accurate records of credit notes, adjustments and refunds.

Assist with recurring invoices and subscription-based billing arrangements.



3. Accounts Payable & Expense Management



Receive, review and process supplier invoices.

Record expenses and allocate them to the correct accounts and business entities.

Reconcile expenses and supporting receipts using Xero.

Maintain accurate supplier records.

Monitor payment due dates and prepare payment schedules.

Identify duplicate invoices, incorrect charges and missing supporting documents.

Reconcile supplier statements and outstanding balances.

Track recurring business expenses and subscriptions.

Prepare payments for management approval.

Maintain accurate records of approved and completed payments.



4. Stripe & Online Payment Administration



We use Stripe to process online customer payments.



The successful candidate will be expected to become familiar with our Stripe payment processes and ensure transactions are accurately reflected in Xero.



Responsibilities include:



Monitor Stripe transactions, settlements and payouts.

Reconcile Stripe payments against customer invoices and bank receipts.

Record and reconcile Stripe processing fees.

Identify and investigate failed payments, refunds and discrepancies.

Assist with reconciling recurring payments and subscription transactions.

Maintain accurate records of online payment activity.

Ensure Stripe transactions are correctly allocated to the relevant business entity.

Help improve the integration and reconciliation processes between Stripe and Xero.



Previous experience with Stripe would be a significant advantage.



5. Monthly Financial Reporting



We expect our bookkeeping records to be sufficiently accurate and current to support reliable monthly management reporting.



Responsibilities include:



Prepare monthly Profit & Loss reports for each of our four business entities.

Prepare consolidated financial summaries for management review.

Produce monthly balance sheet reports.

Prepare aged receivables and aged payables reports.

Report on outstanding invoices and overdue customer payments.

Prepare monthly summaries of revenue, expenses and cash balances.

Identify unusual expenses, material variances and transactions requiring attention.

Assist with basic cash flow monitoring and forecasting.

Maintain monthly financial reporting schedules.

Ensure reports are prepared accurately and delivered on time.



We want someone who can do more than generate reports. We value candidates who can identify issues, explain discrepancies and highlight matters requiring management attention.



6. External Accountants & Compliance Support



We engage external accountants to support our accounting, tax and statutory reporting obligations.



The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring our accountants receive accurate, complete and well-organised financial information.



Responsibilities include:



Act as the principal administrative contact for our external accountants.

Maintain organised financial records and supporting documentation.

Prepare and provide requested financial reports and reconciliations.

Maintain records of invoices, receipts, expenses and other financial transactions.

Assist with preparing information required for tax filings and statutory reporting.

Respond to accountants' questions and requests for supporting information.

Track outstanding accounting queries and ensure timely responses.

Assist with year-end financial reporting and audit preparation.

Maintain a structured database of financial records and documents for each entity.

Help ensure financial reporting and compliance deadlines are met.



7. General Business Administration



In addition to bookkeeping, the role will include general administrative support.



Responsibilities include:



Maintain accurate customer and supplier databases.

Assist with administrative record keeping and document management.

Prepare spreadsheets, reports and business records.

Help maintain organised electronic filing systems.

Support improvements to internal administrative processes.

Assist with routine operational tasks as required.



8. Marketing Database & Business Development Support



GLS Group is expanding its marketing operations and establishing a dedicated Philippines-based marketing support team.



Initially, you will assist with certain marketing administration and database-related activities.



These may include:



Maintaining and updating contact databases.

Entering, reviewing and correcting customer and prospect information.

Identifying and removing duplicate or inaccurate records.

Assisting with database segmentation and categorisation.

Supporting the preparation of contact lists for marketing campaigns.

Helping maintain accurate records in ActiveCampaign and related systems.

Assisting with other routine marketing administration tasks.



As our marketing team expands, dedicated marketing specialists will assume responsibility for these activities.



This is an opportunity to develop a broader understanding of our businesses while helping establish the systems and processes that will support our future growth.



What We're Looking For



Essential Requirements



At least five years of practical bookkeeping experience, preferably supporting small or medium-sized businesses.

Strong working knowledge of Xero, including invoicing, bank reconciliation, expense management and financial reporting.

Experience managing the full bookkeeping cycle.

Demonstrated ability to prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements and other management reports.

Experience managing accounts receivable, accounts payable and bank reconciliations.

Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Very good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.

Ability to work independently, identify problems and take ownership of their resolution.

Confidence communicating with Directors, suppliers, customers and external accountants.

Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity.

A dedicated, quiet home office, suitable for professional video calls and uninterrupted work, with reliable high-speed internet.



Highly Desirable



Previous experience managing bookkeeping for multiple business entities.

Experience with Stripe payment processing and reconciliation.

Experience working with international businesses.

Familiarity with Singapore or UAE accounting and reporting requirements.

Experience with recurring invoicing and subscription-based businesses.

Experience with professional services businesses.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

Experience with ActiveCampaign or similar CRM platforms.

Experience maintaining business databases and administrative records.

What We Offer

A long-term position with an established international business.

Responsibility for the bookkeeping and financial administration of four business entities.

Direct interaction with senior management.

Interesting and varied responsibilities.

Opportunities to develop financial, administrative and operational skills.

Exposure to international business operations.

The opportunity to help establish and develop our Philippines-based support team.

How to Apply



Please submit:



Your CV, detailing your relevant bookkeeping experience.

Your current or most recent monthly salary.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Your availability to commence employment.

A short video introduction (maximum two minutes) explaining your professional background, bookkeeping experience and why you are interested in this position.



You may record the video using your phone or computer. No special equipment or editing is required. Please provide the video or a shareable link that can be viewed without requesting access.



Please also answer the following questions:



1. Xero Experience



How many years have you used Xero, and which bookkeeping functions have you personally managed using the platform?



2. Multiple Entities



Have you previously managed bookkeeping for more than one business entity? If so, how many, and what were your responsibilities?



3. Monthly Reporting



What financial reports did you prepare in your most recent position? Were you personally responsible for preparing monthly Profit & Loss statements?



4. Stripe Experience



Have you worked with Stripe or another online payment platform? If so, explain how you reconciled customer payments, transaction fees and bank settlements.



5. Independent Responsibility



Describe a bookkeeping discrepancy or financial reporting problem you personally identified and resolved.



We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate accuracy, initiative, sound judgment, reliability and the ability to manage their responsibilities independently.

title: Full-Time Video Editor — Movement, Anatomy & Meaningful Education
description:
This role will challenge and grow you.



I’m looking for a skilled video editor to help me produce content that blends science, movement and healing.



If you enjoy clear educational storytelling, clean motion design and visuals that help people understand what they’re seeing, this could be a great fit.



You need strong video editing and motion graphics skills. Experience superimposing skeletal anatomy onto human movement is welcome, but you can learn that application in this role. You’ll need the interest, initiative and technical foundation to develop it.



Who I Am



I run two yoga-based companies:



* One trains yoga professionals in anatomy-informed, therapeutic practice.

* The other helps people reduce pain and rebuild trust in their bodies through mindful movement.



My teaching brings biomechanics and yoga together. The visuals need to reflect that: calm, focused and clear. Not flashy, chaotic or driven by constant jump cuts.



I work with a small team of VAs hired through this platform. We work well together, enjoy what we’re building, and I’m looking for someone who would enjoy contributing to that team.



What You’ll Produce



Our regular weekly output will be:



* One 7–10-minute YouTube video.

* Five 1–3-minute clips, each formatted for YouTube, Instagram and
.

* Thumbnails, titles and descriptions, plus uploading and scheduling.



The footage will include me teaching to camera and demonstrating movement. Short clips will come from both longer recordings and separately recorded short videos.



Skeletal overlays will appear in selected sections where they help explain the teaching - not throughout every video. Other visuals may include animated diagrams, simple text and anatomical illustrations.



We’ll begin with a production phase to build a buffer of content before moving into the regular publishing schedule. Together, we’ll agree on a realistic timeline for getting a few weeks ahead and maintaining that buffer.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



* Editing long-form and short-form educational videos.

* Selecting useful excerpts from longer recordings while preserving the meaning of the teaching.

* Superimposing skeletal and anatomical visuals onto movement footage.

* Creating clear, purposeful motion graphics.

* Polishing audio, captions, pacing and visual consistency.

* Creating thumbnails and writing titles and descriptions that accurately reflect the content.

* Formatting, uploading and scheduling approved videos across platforms.

* Keeping footage, assets, exports and editable project files organized in our shared storage.



Editable project files and the assets needed to continue working on them must be included in the handoff, alongside final exported videos.



Anatomical Accuracy and Learning



You’ll provide the editing software, tools and appropriately licensed anatomy assets needed for your work.



I can provide direction about the anatomy, movement and what a visual needs to communicate. You’ll also be expected to develop your understanding over time and take initiative in learning how to create accurate overlays.



Anatomical accuracy matters, as does preserving the meaning of my teaching. When something is unclear, I want you to ask.



I’ll provide feedback and final approval before content is published.



Who This Role Is For



You’re someone who:



* Has strong editing and motion graphics skills.

* Can already create skeletal overlays or is ready to learn.

* Understands how pacing and visual tone support calm, clear education.

* Enjoys making complex ideas easier to understand.

* Is collaborative, detail-oriented and reliable.

* Can manage deadlines and communicate progress without micromanagement.

* Responds well to feedback and grows more independent as you learn the work.



Experience with education, health or wellness content is welcome.



Tools and Technical Skills



Please tell me which software and subscriptions you have and use confidently.



Relevant skills include:



* Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, or equivalent tools.

* Motion tracking and compositing.

* Animated diagrams and simple text animation.

* Talking-head editing and audio cleanup.

* Long-form educational pacing.

* Short-form editing and platform formatting.

* Thumbnail creation and consistent visual design.



You’ll also need stable, strong internet for transferring footage and project files.



Working Together



This is intended to be a full-time role.



You can organize your working hours around agreed deadlines. I’m in Mountain Time and typically connect in the early morning. Please tell me your time zone and your availability to meet during that window.



Skill, reliability, communication and meeting deadlines matter most.



Examples of My Existing Content



Skeletal overlays:





See 10:34.





See 5:51.



Other teaching visuals:





See 2:44, 3:33 and 5:23.





See 0:51, 5:06, 5:21, 6:49 and 7:06.



To Apply



Please:



* Share your editing and motion graphics portfolio.

* Include up to two examples of skeletal overlays if you have them. If this is new for you, share relevant tracking or compositing work and explain what you would need to learn.

* Confirm which editing tools and subscriptions you have.

* Confirm that you have stable, strong internet.

* Tell me about any experience with education, health or wellness brands.

* Confirm your availability for full-time work, your time zone and your availability for early-morning Mountain Time meetings.

* Include your expected compensation.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small test using my footage, including a brief skeletal overlay section.



If you enjoy creating intelligent, thoughtful visuals and want to grow alongside this work, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Pantry Partners 



Multi-brand CPG support · Founding team member · Build the systems from day 



 Applications Only - no platform applications considered 



ABOUT PANTRY PARTNERS 



Pantry Partners is the back office behind ambitious, founder-led food and drink brands. We run the operations, admin, content and data that founders don't have time for, so they can focus on building the brand. We're also a venture studio, launching and incubating our own brands alongside the ones we support.



We're led by an exited founder who spent 10 years building and scaling a CPG food brand in Ireland. That experience shaped one belief: founders need to focus on their zone of genius to create generation defining brands. This  is almost never back office functions and that's where Pantry Partners comes in. 



We're brand new. There's no rulebook, no legacy process and no "that's how we've always done it". For the right person, that's the exciting part. If you love creating systems, defining ways of working and seeing your structure become the way a whole company runs, you'll help build Pantry Partners from the ground up.



A FLAVOUR FOR THE ROLE 



You'll be the organisational backbone across our portfolio of brands. Each founder gets a dedicated 2 hours of your day. 

You'll start with two: one existing external client brand and one brand we're incubating in-house. The rest of your week goes into building Pantry Partners itself: the SOPs, templates and tools that let us take on new brands without starting from scratch. Your job is to keep each brand's engine running quietly in the background, so founders can spend their time on creative, strategic, high-value work. 



THE BREAD AND BUTTER



• Founder Inbox triage and daily briefing - Work through each founder's inbox every morning. Send a short daily brief on what needs attention, framed against that founders' priorities. The founder d
, you execute.



• Calendar and scheduling - Own calendars across brands. Protect focus time, batch meetings, and make sure every meeting has a purpose and an agenda.



• General business admin - Keep the day-to-day running smoothly: organised shared drives, filed contracts and documents, tracked software subscriptions, and collected receipts. Stay ahead of renewals and deadlines, prepare forms and paperwork, and tidy up documents and decks so they're ready to send.



• Invoicing and light bookkeeping for Pantry Partners - Raise invoices on schedule, track payments and follow up on overdue ones. Keep a clean running record of income and outgoings that's easy to review at a glance.



• Research - Markets, suppliers, competitors, retailers, guests for content. Go deep and come back with a clean, one-page summary.



• Data cleaning - Turn messy spreadsheets, contact lists and databases into something usable. Founders shouldn't have to touch raw data.



• Meeting notes and follow-ups - Capture decisions and actions from virtual note taker, then make sure they happen.



• Travel and logistics for Pantry Partners founder - Book flights, accommodation and transfers for trade shows, supplier visits and meetings.



• Systems and SOPs - Document every recurring task as a repeatable process. Build the templates, trackers and checklists that let Pantry Partners support new brands without starting from scratch.



• Founder life admin and goals - Help the Pantry Partners founder stay on top of a varied life across countries, businesses and commitments. Manage personal appointments, bills and renewals, and keep work and personal plans from clashing. Support his personal operating system (The Engine) by tracking goals, weekly metrics and 90-day priorities, flagging where he's off track and prompting him on commitments. Essentially you're keeping a busy, curious person accountable! 



OUR ESSENTIAL INGREDIENTS 



• Time is sacred - Your core job is to buy back founders' time. Every task you take off their plate is a win. Every unnecessary interruption is a loss.



• Low noise - Don't bring problems, bring recommendations. Batch your questions. Only ask when you genuinely need a decision.



• Systems, not reminders - Build repeatable processes so nothing falls through the cracks. Nobody should need to chase you on recurring work.



• Clean separation - Each brand gets its own time, focus and confidentiality. What happens in one brand stays in that brand.



YOUR SECRET SAUCE - WHY YOU ARE PERFECT FOR PANTRY PARTNERS 



• You have Marie Kondo levels of organisation: everything has a place, nothing is left vague or half-done. 



• You communicate clearly and directly, without fluff. If something needs doing, you do it. You don't wait to be asked twice.



• You're energised by building something new. Early-stage brands mean shifting priorities and plenty of ambiguity, and you enjoy creating structure where there is none. Juggling several brands doesn't faze you, because you've built the system that keeps them separate.



• You bring a positive, sunny attitude. We believe work can and should be fun, so let's lean into that. 



YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU ARE: 



• Obsessively organised and analytical

• Proactive and self-directed

• A systems builder who loves documenting how things work

• Excellent in written and spoken English

• Low-ego and comfortable owning outcomes

• Confident with Google Workspace, spreadsheets and project-management tools (Trello, Notion or similar)



Experience supporting e-commerce, food, drink or consumer brands is a bonus, not a requirement.



WE'RE SERVING UP 



• Hours: Full-time from day one - 40 hours a week (8 hours a day, 5 days a week, Monday to Friday).

• Timezone: Flexible within Manila hours. We'll agree a daily overlap window for each brand where possible.

• Communication: Mostly async via WhatsApp ,
 and other shared tools, with short briefing calls as needed.

• Trial: A paid, part-time trial of 2–4 weeks before we formalise, with hours to be mutually agreed, at ₱350 per hour.

• Pay: €840 per month, plus 13th month pay.

• Growth: This is a long-term, founding role. As Pantry Partners grows, so does your responsibility, with a clear path to leading the support team.



HOW TO APPLY 



Record a short video (2 minutes max, Loom is perfect) walking us through something you've organised: your Google Drive, your week, even your kitchen cupboard. Show us how it works and why you set it up that way. Send it with your CV, using the subject line "Reporting for Pantry Duty: [your favourite food]".
 to 
 applications who follow this process will be considered.

**Employment:** Full-time, long-term

**Work Arrangement:** Remote, with potential to transition to an office-based team

**Reporting to:** GLS Group Directors / Marketing Operations Lead



### About GLS Group



GLS Group is an international legal services business operating across Singapore, Dubai and other international markets.



Our businesses provide legal operations consulting, managed legal services and innovative legal support solutions for startups and growing businesses.



We operate several websites and maintain substantial databases of corporate contacts, professional decision-makers, customers and prospective clients.



We are expanding our international marketing activities and establishing a dedicated Philippines-based marketing support team.



### The Opportunity

**1. Marketing Database Growth**



Research companies and professional contacts, identify relevant decision-makers and systematically expand our marketing databases.



**2. Website Content Publishing**



Upload, format and publish articles, blogs, marketing materials and other content across our websites.



We already produce substantial marketing content and have clear target audiences.



Your responsibility will be to ensure our databases continue to grow and our content is published accurately, professionally and consistently.



**We want someone who enjoys research, is comfortable working with digital systems and takes pride in producing accurate, high-quality work.**



This is a hands-on role offering an opportunity to develop practical experience in international digital marketing operations.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Marketing Database Research & Growth**



An important part of this position will be systematically expanding our databases of relevant companies and professional contacts.



Responsibilities include:



* Research companies operating in our target industries and geographic markets.

* Identify relevant business decision-makers and professional contacts.

* Research general counsel, legal operations leaders, legal executives, founders and senior business managers.

* Identify companies matching defined target customer profiles.

* Research and record relevant company and contact information.

* Use LinkedIn, company websites, professional directories and other research sources.

* Identify and verify professional
 addresses using appropriate tools.

* Maintain accurate records of research sources and contact information.

* Organise prospects into clearly defined target groups.

* Support the development of targeted marketing contact lists.

* Work towards agreed database growth and research targets.



**We are looking for someone who can research intelligently, rather than simply copy information from websites.**



**2. Database Management & Data Quality**



Database quality is as important as database growth.



Responsibilities include:

* Correct incomplete, inconsistent or outdated information.

* Categorise contacts by geography, industry, company and professional role.

* Maintain consistent database formatting and naming conventions.

* Assist with maintaining contact records in ActiveCampaign.

* Identify and flag inaccurate or questionable information.

* Maintain appropriate records of contact sources and marketing permissions.

* Follow established data protection and database management procedures.



**3. Website Content Uploading & Publishing**



GLS Group operates several websites containing articles, resources, marketing materials and educational content.



We regularly produce new material that needs to be uploaded and published.



Responsibilities include:

* Format headings, paragraphs, lists, tables and other content elements.

* Add images, graphics and supporting documents.

* Insert internal and external hyperlinks.

* Upload downloadable resources and marketing materials.

* Identify and report broken links, formatting problems and publishing errors.

* Apply appropriate headings and content structures.

* Maintain appropriate page URLs and content categories.

* Add internal links to relevant website resources.

* Help maintain consistent website content standards.



You will not be expected to develop our SEO strategy. However, you should understand how to publish content in a search-engine-friendly manner.

* Assist with organising campaign contact lists.

* Support database segmentation activities.

* Maintain records of marketing content and publication schedules.

* Assist with ActiveCampaign contact administration.

* Support LinkedIn research and prospect identification.

* Assist with other marketing support activities when required.

* Strong internet research skills.

title: Creative Lead: Video Editor & Brand Designer
description:
Video · Design · Motion graphics · Brand identity · Founding creative



 Applications Only - no platform applications considered



ABOUT PANTRY PARTNERS



Pantry Partners is the back office behind ambitious, founder-led food and drink brands. We run the operations, admin, content and data that founders don't have time for, so they can focus on building the brand. We're also a venture studio, launching and incubating our own brands alongside the ones we support.



We're led by an exited founder who spent 10 years building and scaling a CPG food brand in Ireland. That experience shaped one belief: founders need to focus on their zone of genius to create generation-defining brands. That's almost never back-office work, and that's where Pantry Partners comes in.



We're brand new. There's no brand book, no house style and no "that's how we've always done it". For the right creative, that's the exciting part. You'll define how Pantry Partners looks and sounds, and help shape the brands we build from day one.



A FLAVOUR FOR THE ROLE



You'll be our founding creative: the person who makes everything we put into the world look and feel great. We're looking for a true creative all-rounder who is as comfortable editing video as designing brand identities, and who brings real flair to both.

You'll work across four creative briefs from day one:



1) Pantry Partners - Build our brand identity from scratch



2) An existing client brand - Create content and design for a founder-led food and drink brand already in market. Here you'll be working within the confines of an existing brand and supporting a founder who eats, sleeps and breathes brand. 



3) Our first in-house brand - We'll launch our own CPG brand in 2027, and you'll work on everything from brand identity and packaging to organic social and paid ads.



4) Our founder's personal brand - Short-form video focused content documenting the journey of creating our first brand to build an audience pre-launch and authority in the space before we launch our second in-house brand in 2028



As we launch and incubate new ideas, you'll be involved in them all from scratch. For a creative who loves building brands, it's a rare chance to shape several from the very first sketch.



THE BREAD AND BUTTER



• Brand identity - Logos, colour palettes, typography and brand guidelines, starting with Pantry Partners and extending to new brands we launch.



• Short-form video - Edit Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts from raw footage, interviews and podcasts. Hooks, pacing, captions and sound that stop the scroll.



• Long-form video - Edit interviews, founder content and brand films into polished, watchable pieces.



• Motion graphics - Animated titles, lower thirds, logo animations and branded templates that make every video feel on-brand.



• Social and ad creative - Static posts, carousels, thumbnails and paid-ad variations, built to test and iterate quickly.



• Packaging and print - Support packaging, sell-in decks, retailer materials and point-of-sale design.



• Templates and asset libraries - Build reusable templates and a tidy asset library for each brand, so great content is fast to make and consistent every time.



OUR ESSENTIAL INGREDIENTS



• Taste first - Every piece should look like it belongs to its brand. If it's not good enough to post, it's not finished.

• Speed with quality - Social moves fast. Hit agreed deadlines without cutting corners, and flag early if something will slip.

• Bring ideas, not just edits - Don't wait for a perfect brief. Suggest hooks, formats and trends worth trying.

• Organised files - Clear naming, tidy folders and version control. Anyone should be able to find any asset in seconds.

• Clean separation - Each brand gets its own look, voice and confidentiality. What happens in one brand stays in that brand.



YOUR SECRET SAUCE - WHY YOU'RE PERFECT FOR US



You're a true creative with global taste. Your references come from New York, Tokyo and London, and your work holds its own next to any of them. You build brands that look at home on the shelves at Erewhon. You can take a rough idea and turn it into something people want to watch, share and buy. You notice the details: a frame that's slightly off, a kerning gap, a cut that lands a beat late.



You're energised by building something new. There's no house style yet, and you see that as an invitation, not a problem. You're happy switching between four brands in a day, because you know exactly what makes each one different.

You bring a positive, sunny attitude. We believe work can and should be fun, so let's lean into that.



YOU'LL THRIVE IF YOU ARE: 



• Skilled in video editing, graphic design and motion graphics, with a portfolio to prove it

• Fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator 

• Experienced in creating or evolving a brand identity

• Up to date on social trends, formats and what makes short-form content work

• Proactive, self-directed and organised

• Excellent in written and spoken English

• Low-ego and open to feedback



Experience with food, drink or consumer brands is a bonus, not a requirement.



WE'RE SERVING UP



• Hours: Full-time from day one: 40 hours a week (8 hours a day, 5 days a week).

• Timezone: Flexible within Manila hours. We'll agree a daily overlap window where possible.

• Communication: Mostly async via WhatsApp,
 and shared tools, with short creative reviews as needed.

• Trial: A paid trial of 2–4 weeks before we formalise.

• Pay: €1,100, plus 13th month pay.

• Growth: This is a long-term, founding role. As Pantry Partners grows, so does your responsibility, with a clear path to leading the creative team.



TO APPLY 



Send your portfolio and CV plus a 30 to 60 second video introducing yourself and why we should hire you, edited the way you'd edit a Reel for a brand. Show us your personality and your style. Use the subject line "Future Pantry Partners Creative: [insert your favourite food]".
 to 
 applications who follow this process will be considered.

• Strong English communication and customer follow-up skills

Your resume

Maintain accurate records and organise business information.

Maintain internal systems, databases and document libraries.

Monitor deadlines, outstanding tasks and operational requirements.

Research suppliers, service providers and business opportunities.

Help develop and improve internal administrative procedures.

Help coordinate LinkedIn outreach and
 marketing campaigns.

Coordinate the publication of articles and marketing content.

Maintain campaign schedules and monitor delivery.

At least five years of relevant executive assistant or business administration experience.

Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, confidently and professionally.

Strong communication skills, including the ability to understand instructions, ask sensible questions, provide concise updates and follow through on commitments.

Strong Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

Confidence working directly with senior executives.

Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment and take ownership of responsibilities.

Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity.

An interest in developing team leadership and management responsibilities.

A dedicated, quiet home office, suitable for professional video calls and uninterrupted work, with reliable high-speed internet.

•  Act as the senior escalation point for complex i
; bring structure to root-cause analysis, corrective action and major service recovery.



2  Outsourced IT management and customer liaison

•  Act as the accountable IT/technical-service lead for assigned outsourcing clients, initially including a UK-based sister company.

•  Build effective relationships with directors, operational leaders, education-sector stakeholders and nominated client contacts; translate technical issues into business impact and decisions.

•  Lead technical service reviews, operational reporting, risk and lifecycle assessments, improvement roadmaps, project meetings and supplier escalations.

•  Own service-optimisation actions and oversee client delivery against agreed contracts, SLAs, budgets and authorised scopes without making unapproved commercial commitments.

•  Support technical scoping, effort estimates, project proposals, standardisation and sensible technology recommendations for clients.



3  Advanced Microsoft 365, cloud and identity

•  Provide expert oversight of Microsoft 365 administration, tenant health, migrations and i
 resolution, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and collaboration controls.

•  Lead Entra ID, identity and access governance, MFA, Conditional Access, licensing, Microsoft Intune / endpoint management, and Microsoft Defender / security configuration.

•  Review security posture, mail flow, permissions, device policy, configuration drift and service lifecycle; guide engineers through remediation and documented changes.

•  Work confidently with associated Azure/cloud services, hybrid identity and integration dependencies where present.



4  Networking, wireless, server and remote-access architecture

•  Design, diagnose and improve business networking: switching, routing, firewalls, VLANs, WAN, site-to-site and remote-access VPNs, TCP/IP, DNS and DHCP.

•  Own wireless architecture and troubleshooting: access-point placement, coverage and capacity, roaming, channel planning, authentication, segmentation and security for business and school environments.

•  Support Windows Server and hybrid estates including Active Directory, Group Policy, file services, virtualisation, backup dependencies and operational resilience.

•  Provide technical leadership for Remote Desktop, RDS and other approved remote-access technologies, including permissions and secure administration.



5  RMM, help desk, patches and endpoint standards

•  Manage remote monitoring and management (RMM), asset visibility, alerting, endpoint maintenance and proactive fault identification across client estates.

•  Own the controlled deployment of Windows, server, application and security updates, including patch policy, testing, rollout rings, scheduling, failure remediation and rollback.

•  Drive help-desk quality through clear tickets, next actions, accurate time recording, knowledge capture, escalation controls and meaningful performance dashboards.

•  Evaluate safe automation and standard configurations to reduce repeat i
, avoidable manual work and service risk.



6  Remote project and deployment leadership

•  Plan and lead remote Microsoft 365, endpoint, server, network and wireless deployments, upgrades and migrations, coordinating engineers, stakeholders and third-party vendors.

•  Define technical scope, dependencies, milestones, owners, labour estimates, access requirements, test plans, cutovers, customer communication and acceptance criteria.

•  Control delivery risks, project hours, change approval, backups, rollback arrangements, documentation, handover and lessons learned.

•  Use agreed project systems and ensure client commitments remain realistic, properly authorised and visible to the Managing Director.



7  Security, governance and continuous improvement

•  Apply least privilege, secure remote access, MFA, endpoint security, data protection, supplier coordination and robust change management.

•  Coordinate major outages, suspected cyber i
, evidence preservation, customer communication, recovery actions and preventative measures.

•  Understand UK GDPR obligations and the additional safeguarding and filtering/monitoring expectations when supporting schools.

•  Provide the Managing Director with concise, evidence-based reporting on customer risks, service performance, technical debt, projects, engineer development and decisions required.



Essential experience and capabilities

•  Typically 8+ years in IT infrastructure, technical support and service delivery, including at least 3 years leading or managing technical engineers; equivalent demonstrable experience is welcomed.

•  Proven remote team management and engineer coaching, including improvement of service quality, delivery discipline and individual performance.

•  Advanced hands-on technical capability across Microsoft 365 and associated identity, security, collaboration and device-management services.

•  Advanced networking and wireless architecture, Windows Server, Active Directory, Remote Desktop/RDS and secure remote access.

•  Operational experience with RMM, help-desk/ticketing platforms, patch/update deployments and structured i
 management.

•  Ability to scope and lead technical projects and deployments remotely, manage competing customer priorities and apply change controls.

•  Strong client communication, ownership of service outcomes, problem-solving judgement, English written/verbal skills and executive-level reporting.

•  Comfortable working autonomously in a growing services business, building practical processes while remaining willing to handle complex technical escalations.

•  Able to maintain the agreed full-time UK-business-hours service coverage from a reliable, professional and secure remote working environment.



Preferred experience

•  Managed Service Provider (MSP), IT outsourcing or multi-client technical-services leadership, especially in UK-facing delivery teams.

•  Support for UK businesses, schools/education, charities or similarly regulated customer environments.

•  Zoho Desk, Zoho Projects and Zoho Assist; Datto RMM; Microsoft Intune, Defender, Azure and Entra.

•  Cisco, Fortinet or comparable firewall/switching platforms; business Wi-Fi design, RADIUS, web filtering and monitoring.

•  Backup/disaster recovery, cybersecurity/MDR, business connectivity or VoIP; ITIL, Microsoft, networking or project-management certifications.

•  Technical pre-sales, project estimation, client roadmap/QBR delivery, service profitability or contract-scope management.



What success looks like in your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS Understand client obligations and technical estates; assess engineer capability, help-desk/RMM/patching maturity and major risks; establish clear escalation and customer-reporting routines.



BY 60 DAYS Agree a service-improvement roadmap and baseline KPIs; implement priority ticket, documentation and patching controls; launch structured engineer coaching and client service reviews.



BY 90 DAYS Lead measurable improvements in one or more client environments, demonstrate controlled project delivery, show reduced recurring issues and maintain a reliable operating/reporting cadence.



Performance will be assessed against service responsiveness and backlog health, i
/reopen trends, patch compliance, project outcomes, documentation quality, customer confidence and measurable engineer development.



Availability and contractor terms

Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Typical UK daytime coverage translates to late afternoon/evening in the Philippines and may extend past midnight. Confirm any constraints before applying. Exact coverage blocks and the 40-hour weekly scope will be agreed in writing.



•  This is an ongoing, full-time independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, scope, weekly hours, currency, invoicing and payment terms will be confirmed in a written agreement. 



•  You are responsible for applicable registrations, permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.



•  Provide and maintain a suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, with practical backup arrangements. Include normal equipment, utilities, connectivity and operating costs in the quoted fee.



•  Use only approved remote-access, RMM, ticketing and security systems; protect client information and observe confidentiality, least-privilege and information-security requirements.



•  No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Client-specific licences, approved technical access and additional expenses are handled separately; expenditure requires prior approval.



•  Organise your work independently to deliver agreed results, availability, service levels and security outcomes. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations are not waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



How to apply

Apply through this job board or contact recruitment at 
, quoting “Senior IT Manager / Outsourced Technical Services Manager”. We review suitable applications as they arrive.
