title: E-Commerce Customer Support Operator
description:
We are a growing e-commerce support provider. We place trained Filipino operators inside US e-commerce brands. We are hiring CS Operators.



This is not a general VA role. You will own one brand's customer inbox and write in that brand's voice, using the systems and standards we certify you on.



### What you will do



You handle the front line of a US brand's customer inbox.



That means tickets across
 and chat, "where is my order" questions with live carrier lookups, returns and exchanges processed to the brand's SOP, and responses to product reviews and Trustpilot.



You also triage escalations. Anything involving refunds, chargebacks or disputes gets routed, not handled. CS Operators carry no money-movement authority. That boundary protects you as much as it protects the client.



You keep a daily ticket log and track your own CSAT.



### Who this is for



You have at least 12 months handling a real online store's customer inbox. Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Lazada, Shopee, WooCommerce, eBay, Etsy or BigCommerce all count.



You have worked inside a ticketing or seller messaging platform. Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, Re:amaze, Intercom, Tidio, or a marketplace message center.



You write English that needs no editing. You can sound warm and casual for one brand and precise and formal for another, on the same set of facts.



You can handle tickets around 80+ per day.



Shopify admin experience is a strong plus. It is not required if the rest of your profile is strong.



### The hours, stated plainly



Our current clients are US brands, so most shifts follow US business hours. Depending on which client you are placed with, your shift will fall somewhere in this range:



- US Eastern client: 9:00pm to 6:00am PHT

- US Central client: 10:00pm to 7:00am PHT

- US Pacific client: 12:00am to 9:00am PHT



You must be available to work in any time zone, depending on where we assign you. We may place you with a client outside the US. For US clients, your shift also moves by one hour twice a year when the US changes clocks.



We ask for your preferred schedule in the application. We will consider it, but your final shift depends on the client you are assigned to.



We are telling you this before you apply because we would rather you d
 now than in month two. If a shift that changes with the client does not fit your life, this role will not fit either.



### How you get in



Four steps. Application, a short skills assessment, a written and video assessment, then a live interview.



If you pass, you are offered a seat in the CS Certification Bootcamp.



### About the Bootcamp



Three days, paid at $2.50/hr, eight hours a day.



Before Day 1 you complete a short self-paced pre-work module, about 3 hours, covering Shopify admin and helpdesk basics. Finishing it is a condition of keeping your seat.



During Bootcamp you are trained on brand voice, our tag taxonomy and macro library, Shopify order admin, returns and exchanges, de-escalation, and escalation routing.



It ends with a 50-ticket simulation. You need a 90% QA score to certify.



Be clear on this: **a Bootcamp seat is not a job offer.** Certification is what earns deployment. We pay you for the three days either way, and we tell you your score honestly.



### Pay and the path forward



Starting rate is $3.00/hr to start, with a defined progression path



That is a starting number, and it is attached to a path. Certified operators move up:



**CS Operator → Senior CS Operator → CS Resolution Specialist**



Each tier carries a higher rate and more authority. The Resolution Specialist tier holds money authority: refunds, chargebacks and disputes.



Movement is based on certification and QA performance, not on how long you have been here. We fill senior roles from our own bench first, which is why we care so much about who we let into Bootcamp.



You also get: paid Bootcamp days, a certification that belongs to you, written SOPs and a Brand Bible for every client, a named escalation path so you are never guessing alone, and a QA scorecard so you always know where you stand.



### What we need from you



- A computer at i5, Ryzen 5, M1 or better, with 8GB RAM

- Internet at 20 Mbps down and 10 Mbps up, wired or stable fiber

- A named backup internet connection

- Backup power covering at least 30 minutes

- A quiet, dedicated workspace and a headset

- Availability for the pre-work and all three Bootcamp days

- Availability to work any time zone, based on client assignment

- Willingness to give one reference from a past CS supervisor or client



### To apply



Answer the questions below. Please answer them yourself, in your own words. We read every one, and specific answers move forward.



Please put your resume link and a loom video introduction on top of the cover letter so we can easily see and to check if you read the whole job listing.



1. Which online store(s) have you handled customer messages for? For each one, tell us the platform (Shopify, Amazon, Lazada, Shopee or other), the ticketing or messaging tool you used (if you only used
 or WhatsApp, say so), how many months you worked on it, and about how many tickets you handled in a normal day.

2. **Tell me about one specific customer you helped that you still remember. What did they want, what did you do, and how did it end?** (3 to 5 sentences)

3. A customer
s: "This is the third time I'm asking. Where is my order?" You check and the tracking has not moved in 6 days. Write the reply you would send.

4. Have you worked overnight or irregular hours before (graveyard, rotating or weekend shifts)? If yes, for how long and what were the hours? If no, say no.

5. Describe your computer (processor, RAM), your internet speed, your backup internet, and your backup power.

6. What is your current work situation, and when could you start a 3-day Bootcamp?

7. What shift would you prefer, and what hours are you available? This is a preference we will consider. Your final shift depends on the client we assign you to, and you need to be able to work in any time zone.
salary: $3 per hour to start, with progression

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours 



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business. 



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager 



Role Purpose 

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. 



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events. 



What Success Looks Like 

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. 



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. 



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. 



Primary Objectives 

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System 

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR 

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment 

Competitive Advantage 

 

Regular Work Activities 

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) 

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking 

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy 

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates 

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) 

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) 

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs 

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates 

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates 

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals 

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) 

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration 

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR 

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required 

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) 

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement 

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) 

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) 

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) 

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed 

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) 

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) 

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) 

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) 

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) 

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) 



Key Skills 

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) 

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) 

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation 

Organized project management across many ASINs 

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) 

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes 

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) 

 

People Contacts and Interactions 

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) 

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) 

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) 

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment 



Role Requirements 

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred) 

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent) 

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents) 

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work 

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline 

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: E-Commerce Video Editor (AI B-ROLL AND CHARACTERS)
description:
QUICK SUMMARY



Daily Output: 3–4 concepts per day including revisions

Video Length: Typically 60–200 seconds

Focus: High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

Location: Remote

Pay: $10 per completed minute of video for the first month → $15 per completed minute from the second month onwards

Bonus Scheme: Up to $1,000 for winning ads based on performance



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content.



While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback.



Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily Concept Production

Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



AI-Assisted Product Cinematography

Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement and seamless integration into real-world edits.



Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



AI Character & Voice Integration

Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers and emotional delivery when required.



End-to-End Post Production

Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, colour grading, pacing, revisions and final export delivery.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL STACK



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



AI Video Generation



Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

Kling

Luma Dream Machine



Voice / Character Tools



HeyGen

ElevenLabs

D-ID



Image Generation



Midjourney v6+

Leonardo.ai



Editing & Post Production



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop



AI Enhancement



Topaz Video AI

REQUIREMENTS



Speed & Efficiency

You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



Understanding of Advertising

You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling and what makes ads convert.



Attention to Detail

You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion or low-quality visual details.



Strong English & Audio Awareness

Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers or direct voice delivery properly.



Work Ethic & Communication

Communication, reliability, speed and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



PAY



Compensation is based on completed video output.



First Month

$10 per completed minute of video



Second Month Onwards

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

description:
Looking for a long-term editing role where great work can grow from 20 hours/week into a full-time opportunity as the business expands?



We’re a fast-growing Germany-based TikTok Shop affiliate business looking for an excellent short-form editor we can grow with — not a one-off freelancer.



Strong performance can open the door to more hours, higher compensation and a larger role over time.



You focus on great editing. We provide the concepts, scripts/voiceovers, raw footage, references and clear creative direction.





WHAT YOU’LL DO



Turn raw footage into high-retention TikTok Shop videos.



Our recordings often include multiple takes and camera angles, so you need to identify the strongest footage and turn it into a clean, engaging edit.



We care most about:



• Strong hooks in the first seconds

• Excellent pacing and removing dead time

• Choosing the best takes

• Clean cuts and effective visual changes

• Strong sound design and precise SFX timing

• Following references closely without over-editing





WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



An experienced short-form editor who is reliable, detail-oriented and wants to keep improving.



We have high standards, but we provide clear direction and feedback. Honest communication, consistent quality and the willingness to learn and grow with us are very important.





COMPENSATION & GROWTH



• 20 hours/week

• €500/month base salary (€5.77/hour)

• Up to €100/month performance bonus (€600 total / €6.92/hour)

• Weekly payments during the first weeks

• 13th-month pay in accordance with applicable Philippine law

• Paid 2-month probationary period

• Long-term position

• Potential for more hours, higher compensation and eventually full-time work as we grow



The performance bonus is based mainly on editing quality, first-pass quality, reliability, deadlines and organization — not simply whether one TikTok goes viral.



Higher compensation may be available for truly exceptional candidates.





PAID EDITING TEST



Shortlisted candidates will complete a PAID editing test using real raw footage, clear instructions and a reference TikTok Shop video.





HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Your APPLICATION TITLE must begin exactly with:



BLUE MANGO



For example:

BLUE MANGO – Video Editor Application



Applications that do not have BLUE MANGO at the beginning of the application title may not be reviewed.



Then send:



1. Links to your 3 BEST short-form video edits.



2. Briefly tell us about your TikTok / short-form editing experience, previous relevant work and which editing software you use.



3. Confirm that you can reliably commit to 20 hours/week.



4. Would you be interested in increasing your hours toward full-time in the future if the opportunity becomes available?



5. Briefly describe your internet/power reliability and backup setup.



6. Confirm that €500/month base + up to €100/month performance bonus works for you. If your expected compensation is higher, you may state it.



Our goal is to find an excellent, reliable editor who wants to grow with us long-term.

We look forward to reviewing your application and hopefully getting to know you better.

title: CONTENT ASSISTANT
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote



About Our Company



We are a growing business looking for a creative, organized, and detail-oriented Content Assistant to support our content creation and digital marketing activities.



We are looking for someone who understands digital content, enjoys working with modern technology, and can help us create, organize, edit, and publish high-quality content across different platforms.



The ideal candidate is proactive, tech-savvy, comfortable using AI tools, and capable of turning ideas into well-organized content. You should be able to follow brand guidelines, manage deadlines, maintain consistency, and support our content strategy as the business grows.



We want someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail, and is committed to producing quality work consistently. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to develop their content creation and digital marketing skills while contributing to a growing business.



Key Responsibilities

1. Content Research & Planning

Research relevant topics, industry trends, competitors, and audience interests.

Generate content ideas for social media, websites, blogs, and marketing campaigns.

Assist with developing content calendars and weekly publishing schedules.

Research trending topics, relevant keywords, hashtags, and content formats.

Organize content ideas and maintain a library of topics, references, and creative resources.

Help identify opportunities to improve content quality, relevance, and engagement.

2. Content Creation & Writing

Draft social media captions, short-form posts, headlines, and promotional content.

Assist with writing blog posts, website content, product or service descriptions, and marketing materials.

Turn basic ideas, notes, and reference materials into clear, engaging content.

Repurpose existing content into different formats for various platforms.

Proofread and edit content for grammar, spelling, clarity, tone, and consistency.

Ensure all content follows brand guidelines and communicates the intended message.

3. Social Media Content Support

Assist with content preparation for platforms such as
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

Prepare captions, hashtags, graphics, and supporting materials for scheduled posts.

Upload, schedule, and publish approved content using social media management tools.

Organize content assets, drafts, and published posts.

Monitor basic engagement and maintain records of content performance.

Assist with responding to comments or messages when assigned.

Stay informed about platform trends and content best practices.

4. Visual Content & Creative Support

Create or edit basic graphics using Canva or similar design tools.

Assist with preparing branded images, promotional graphics, and social media visuals.

Help organize photos, videos, logos, templates, and other creative assets.

Assist with basic video editing, trimming, subtitles, and formatting for short-form content.

Ensure visuals are properly sized and formatted for their intended platforms.

Maintain visual consistency across content and marketing materials.

5. AI Tools & Content Productivity

Use ChatGPT and other AI-powered tools to brainstorm ideas, conduct research, draft content, and improve productivity.

Use AI tools to assist with content outlines, captions, summaries, and creative concepts.

Explore suitable tools for image creation, video editing, transcription, and content repurposing.

Review and fact-check AI-generated content before publication.

Edit AI-generated drafts to ensure they sound natural, accurate, original, and consistent with our brand voice.

Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive content tasks using templates and efficient workflows.

6. Content Organization & Administration

Maintain an organized content calendar and track upcoming publishing deadlines.

Keep content drafts, final versions, images, videos, and reference files properly organized.

Track the status of content from idea and draft through review, approval, and publication.

Maintain spreadsheets and reports related to content activities.

Coordinate with team members to collect information, feedback, and approvals.

Ensure revisions are completed accurately and content is ready on schedule.

7. Performance Tracking & Improvement

Track basic content metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, and views when available.

Compile simple performance reports and identify patterns in successful content.

Help evaluate which topics and formats perform best.

Use feedback and performance data to suggest improvements.

Stay updated on content marketing practices, social media trends, and emerging tools.

Required Qualifications

Strong written English skills and good grammar.

Excellent attention to detail and proofreading abilities.

Creativity and an interest in digital content and social media.

Familiarity with platforms such as
, Instagram, TikTok, or LinkedIn.

Working knowledge of Canva, Google Workspace, and basic content management tools.

Familiarity with ChatGPT or other AI productivity tools.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

Willingness to learn new software, platforms, and workflows.

Ability to work independently and communicate progress clearly.

Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer for remote work.



Previous experience in content creation, social media management, copywriting, digital marketing, or virtual assistance is preferred. A portfolio or examples of previous work are an advantage.



What Success Looks Like in This Role



The successful candidate will:



Deliver accurate, polished, and well-organized content.

Meet deadlines and maintain a consistent publishing schedule.

Follow brand guidelines and incorporate feedback effectively.

Keep content calendars and digital assets organized.

Use AI and digital tools responsibly to improve efficiency.

Communicate proactively and take ownership of assigned work.

We value quality, consistency, creativity, accountability, and a willingness to improve continuously.



Employment Details

Position: Content Assistant

Employment Type: Full-Time

Commitment: Long-Term

Work Arrangement: Remote

Working Schedule: To be confirmed based on business requirements.

Why Join Our Team?

Work with a growing business and contribute to its digital presence.

Develop practical skills in content creation, social media, and digital marketing.

Gain experience using modern AI tools and creative software.

Take ownership of meaningful content projects.

Collaborate with a team that values creativity, reliability, and professionalism.

title: Graphic Designer, Social and Web Panels (AI-Fluent, 30 hrs/week)
description:
Graphic Designer, Social and Web Panels (AI-Fluent, 30 hrs/week)

Type of work: Part to Full Time

Wage: $650 to $900 USD per month

Hours per week: 30 to start



Job description



If this job isn’t for you, check us 
 on all socials. We’re making history.



About HeartStamp

HeartStamp is the greeting card and invitation brand built for right now. Our assistant Stampy gives people creative designer superpowers, so anyone can send a card that looks like they tried harder, cared more, and nailed it. We make professionally printed cards, HeartStamp digital cards and invitations, sold through our website and iOS app.



Our voice is witty, stylish and culturally fluent, savage-funny and emotionally real. Our visuals have to match: bold, modern, internet-native, never bland.



The role

We need a fast, hands-on graphic designer who lives in the work. You will produce our marketing visuals from start to finish: homepage hero panels, category and promo panels for web and iOS, and a steady stream of social graphics. You will work from an established brand book and a library of finished work, and your job is to extend that look at much higher speed.



This is a maker role, not a strategy seat. Speed with taste is the whole job.



The look

Our homepage hero panels look like product photography. Real printed cards, often personalized with family and friend photos, are staged with props that tell the story: envelopes, wax seals, seasonal details, the HeartStamp app in hand. We have two looks: a clean, light editorial set and a dark, moody set. Both always leave room on the left for the headline. Some panels are still images and some are short motion loops. If your portfolio has product staging, photo card mockups, lifestyle composites or ecommerce hero banners, lead with them.



What you’ll make



-Homepage hero panels, marketing panels, category banners and promo cards for 
 and our iOS app

-Static social posts and carousels for Instagram,
, Pinterest, TikTok and X

-Pinterest graphics built for search and discovery

-Short-form video for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, produced with our in-house Claude skills, then finished and polished in CapCut

-Seasonal campaign sets for our Q4 peak (Christmas, New Year, Valentine’s Day)



How we work

We are an AI-first creative shop. We built our own Claude skills that turn a brief into hero panels and short videos, and we generate imagery with Gen image models. You won’t hand-build everything from scratch. You will run these tools, direct them with sharp prompts, judge what’s good and finish it to a professional standard. If AI is already part of your daily design process, you’ll fly here. If you resist it, this isn’t the right fit.



What we’re looking for



-A strong portfolio of social and web marketing work. Framer, Behance or Dribbble preferred. Bare Google Drive folders will not be reviewed.

-3+ years of professional graphic design, ideally for consumer brands, ecommerce or social-first agencies

-Real fluency in Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma

-Photo card and product mockups: you can drop a customer photo into a card design and make the printed card look real in a styled scene, with believable light, shadow and paper texture

-CapCut video editing (required, not a bonus)

-Daily hands-on use of AI image and video tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or similar. Show us AI-assisted work in your portfolio.

-High output: multiple finished pieces a day without quality slipping

-Strong American pop-culture fluency and a sharp eye for modern design

-C1 English, written and spoken

-Reliable internet, backup power and a private workspace



Schedule



-30 hours per week, remote

-Core overlap: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM ET (9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Manila). The remaining 10 hours are flexible.

Immediate start required



Compensation

$650 to $1000 USD per month for 30 hours a week (about 130 hours a month). Paid hourly based on experience and test results, invoiced monthly and paid via Wise.



How we start

Everyone does a short paid test first. We send you one of our card designs, a sample panel and our hero spec. You build a desktop hero panel for Christmas family photo cards, plus a mobile crop and two social cut-downs. It’s paid at your quoted hourly rate with a time cap. Top candidates may be invited to a paid 2-day trial. We hire on the work.



How to apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph.

 
 with a subject line that starts with STAMPY HERO, and include:

-Your portfolio link

Your hourly rate in USD

One product or lifestyle composite you made, and how you built it

One piece you made with AI tools, and which tools you used



Applications without a portfolio or the subject keyword will not be reviewed.. Looking to hire by Oct 23, 2026. Reviewing applications as they come. Blow us away with your talent and you have a great road ahead with HeartStamp.

title: SEO Manager – Full Time
description:
🏢 Company: Get Me Links

💵 Monthly Fee: $1,000/$1,200 per month, depending on experience, plus performance bonuses

🌍 Location: Fully remote

🕓 Hours: Full-time (flexible, but overlap with 1pm–10pm PH time required)



🎁 What You Get

Your monthly rate is only half the package. You'll also get:

  4 weeks of paid time off

  Performance bonuses tied to results

  A fully remote role: work from wherever you do your best work

  A full tool stack, with no fighting for the software you need

  A team ready to run the services you design, and the training to make that happen

  Close work with our Director of Service Operations

  A flexible schedule, no time tracking



💼 What You'll Be Doing

Get Me Links is an SEO and link-building agency that partners with digital marketing agencies, and we're building new services to grow beyond what we offer today. This is not a client SEO role: you won't run campaigns for individual clients. You'll own our off-page SEO operations and build the ones that don't exist yet, then keep them running well. You'll design new services, prove they work, turn them into processes a team can run, and maintain their quality over time. Link building is your core strength, and you bring a full understanding of SEO, so you can help build services across the whole picture.



Some examples of what we want to build:

  New types of link building beyond what we offer today

  Our own sites for link placement

  Buying expired and auction domains, then restoring them

  Link exchange programs run at scale



Your day-to-day:

  Build new services: find and design new SEO services we can sell and deliver

  Expand our offer: turn opportunities in Local SEO, GEO, AI visibility, listicles and Digital PR into services we can deliver at scale

  Grow the publisher network: build strong publisher relationships, negotiate prices, and run outreach at scale

  Protect link quality: set vetting standards that go beyond DR and traffic, and keep risky or spammy sites out of our network

  Shape link strategy: define best practice for anchor text mix, link velocity, relevance and target page selection

  Audit and analyze: run backlink audits and competitor link gap analysis to find new opportunities

  Apply the full SEO picture: work with our Director of Service Operations to bring on-page and technical knowledge (site speed, keyword targeting, site health) into how we vet sites and shape new services

  Set content standards: define briefs and quality bars for placement content, including how to spot low-quality AI content

  Systemize: turn each service into a repeatable process with SOPs and quality checks

  Train the people who run those services

  Maintain: monitor quality and results, fix what breaks, and update processes as SEO changes

  Measure: track links that stay live and get indexed, how long they last, and their impact on rankings and AI visibility

  Bring the outside in: share new SEO knowledge so the whole team grows past what we already know



🧬 Who You Are

An SEO manager who lives and breathes link building.

You look at a publisher site and immediately see the spam signals, the link farm footprints, or the traffic that isn't real, and you can explain why. You're savvy on how to get links that actually help: velocity, relevance, anchor text and the right tools. You also understand the full spectrum of SEO, so you know a slow site or poor keyword targeting can undermine a great link. You don't just run a playbook, you build one: you take a new idea, test it, prove it works, and turn it into a process a team can follow. You have strong opinions on SEO and can defend them, and you have the discipline to work within agreed standards once a decision is made. You keep up with algorithm changes because you want to.



✅ Requirements

  Deep, hands-on SEO experience, with real strength in off-page and link building

  A proven record of publisher outreach and relationship building at scale

  A sharp eye for link quality and risk: spam signals, link farms, Google spam policies, toxic links, disavow and penalty recovery

  Solid working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO (site speed, keyword targeting, site health), enough to judge site    quality and help shape new services

  Working knowledge across the wider SEO landscape: guest posts, niche edits and brand mentions, listicles, GEO, AI visibility,     Digital PR, Local SEO and backlink audits

  Experience with domain auctions, expired domain vetting and site restoration

  Hands-on skill with Ahrefs and Semrush, plus outreach tools such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream or Hunter

  Proof that you have built a service or process from scratch and kept it running well over time

  Experience leading or training a team

  Reliable internet and availability for the required overlap hours



🔥 Bonus Points If You…

Have an agency or link-selling background

Have experience with domain marketplaces and expired domain tools

Are comfortable with numbers: cost per link, margins and capacity planning



🎯 Your First 90 Days

In your first 90 days, you will:

  Learn our current services, publisher network and quality standards

  Audit our off-page processes and present your top improvement opportunities

  Propose at least one new service with a clear plan, cost model and SOP

  Launch that service as a pilot, with a team trained to run it



📝 How We'll Choose

We want to see the work, not just talk about it, so every applicant goes through the same steps:

1. Application + portfolio. For two or three services, processes or link projects you built, tell us what you made and what your role was, how it performed (links live, indexed, retention, rankings, margins), and what you learned and would do differently.

2. First interview with MJ, our Head of Operations. A conversation about your experience, how you vet link quality, your grasp of on-page and technical SEO basics, and how you turn an idea into a process a team can run.

3. Final interview with our CEO and COO. A deeper conversation on how you would build and pilot a new service, and how you work within agreed standards.

title: Facebook Ads Direct Response Video Editor
description:
QUICK SUMMARY



Daily Output: 3–4 concepts per day including revisions

Video Length: Typically 60–200 seconds

Focus: High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

Location: Remote

Pay: $10 per completed minute of video for the first month → $15 per completed minute from the second month onwards

Bonus Scheme: Up to $1,000 for winning ads based on performance



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content.



While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback.



Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily Concept Production

Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



AI-Assisted Product Cinematography

Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement and seamless integration into real-world edits.



Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



AI Character & Voice Integration

Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers and emotional delivery when required.



End-to-End Post Production

Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, colour grading, pacing, revisions and final export delivery.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL STACK



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



AI Video Generation



Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

Kling

Luma Dream Machine



Voice / Character Tools



HeyGen

ElevenLabs

D-ID



Image Generation



Midjourney v6+

Leonardo.ai



Editing & Post Production



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop



AI Enhancement



Topaz Video AI

REQUIREMENTS



Speed & Efficiency

You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



Understanding of Advertising

You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling and what makes ads convert.



Attention to Detail

You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion or low-quality visual details.



Strong English & Audio Awareness

Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers or direct voice delivery properly.



Work Ethic & Communication

Communication, reliability, speed and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



PAY



Compensation is based on completed video output.



First Month

$10 per completed minute of video



Second Month Onwards

$15 per completed minute of video



The more completed video work you produce, the more you can earn.



BONUS SCHEME FOR WINNING ADS



On top of the normal per-minute pay, there are additional bonuses for ads you create that become winning ads.



$200 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending over $200 per day at a 1.8 ROAS or above = $200 bonus



$1,000 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending $1,000 per day at a 2.0 ROAS or above = $1,000 bonus



These bonuses are paid on top of your normal per-minute video compensation.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work and product ad creatives

Examples of product b-roll and/or talking character content

A list of the AI tools you currently use or pay for regularly



Application Requirement



To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word:



NEURAL

description:
We are a fast growing DTC skincare brand selling premium, ingredient led products to women over 40, across the US and DACH. Full time. Reports to management.



What You’ll Do

• Own our channels: TikTok, Instagram and
, per market.

• Own the content calendar, the posting and the scheduling.

 what gets answered, what gets hidden and what goes to customer service.

• Organic growth, earned attention. This is not a performance marketing role.

• You are fast on a queue. Comment and DM volume under paid social at our spend level is real daily work, not a side task.

/s/53du0aog (about 40 minutes). We only review applications submitted through this link; clicking Apply on OnlineJobs alone is not enough. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph or message us and we'll send it.



THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• US$4-8 per hour, based on demonstrated ability and verified experience; your rate is agreed before training starts

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training

The Head of Client Service & Operations will be your primary escalation point for competing priorities and delivery issues. Account leads will retain responsibility for client relationships, strategy and commercial decisions, and creative leads will retain responsibility for creative quality and approval.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build and manage ClickUp project plans from agreed briefs, with clear deliverables, named owners, realistic deadlines, milestones, dependencies and approval steps.

- Check that briefs and handovers contain the information needed to start work, and follow up on missing information before it causes delays.

- Keep ClickUp as the agreed source of delivery status. Capture actions and decisions from Slack, meetings and campaign documents, with links to the relevant files.

- Prepare and coordinate internal work-in-progress meetings, record decisions and follow actions through to completion.

- Follow up professionally and persistently with team members, including senior staff, on agreed commitments.

- Track assets, feedback, revisions and approvals. Check that deliverables are complete, use the correct versions and specifications, and have the required approvals recorded.

- Coordinate handovers between account service, creative, social, influencer, digital, production and external suppliers where required.

- Identify competing deadlines and check team availability before confirming timings. Flag capacity constraints to the operations lead.

- Flag scope changes, extra deliverables and additional revision rounds to the account lead before they become unplanned work.

- Escalate risks and blockers early, explaining the impact, the decision needed and your recommended next step.

- Prepare concise weekly status updates showing milestones, owners, risks and decisions required. Escalate urgent issues as they arise.

- Coordinate launch-readiness checks and post-campaign wrap-up, including final assets, outstanding actions and handover to reporting or finance owners.

- Improve practical ClickUp templates, views, dashboards and workflows so they are consistent and useful for the team.



ABOUT YOU



- You have experience managing multiple projects in a creative agency, marketing team or similar delivery environment.

- You can turn messy information into a clear, workable plan and keep that plan current.

- You are proactive and comfortable asking questions, following up with senior people and escalating problems respectfully.

- You understand campaign timelines, creative production, approvals, dependencies and handovers.

- You can distinguish a status update from a problem that needs a decision, and suggest a practical next step.

- You have hands-on ClickUp experience, including setting up and maintaining project plans, templates, views or dashboards.

- You write clearly and professionally in English and have strong attention to detail without becoming slow.

- You can work independently while staying closely connected to an Australian team.



TOOLS



ClickUp, Slack and Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Slides.



Familiarity with Canva or Adobe production workflows is useful but not essential.



The focus of this role is project coordination and delivery. Specialist team members will handle paid media buying, social media management, creator sourcing, design and strategy.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Remote role based in the Philippines.

- Full-time, 38 hours per week.

- USD $1,300-$1,900 per month, depending on experience.

- Regular weekday overlap with Australia/Sydney business hours is required. A consistent working schedule will be agreed before starting, taking Sydney daylight saving into account.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:

1. A brief example of a campaign or project that started slipping: what was going wrong, what you personally did and what happened.

2. An example of a ClickUp project plan, template, view, dashboard or workflow you have built or improved. You can describe it or share an anonymised screenshot; please do not share confidential client information.

3. Your availability, earliest start date and the hours you can overlap with Australia/Sydney.



Applications that do not address these points will not be reviewed.

title: Media Buyer (Lead Generation | Performance-Focused)
description:
This role is posted by TRES on behalf of Restive Collective, one of the agencies we support. You’ll be hired by and work directly with the Restive Collective team.



About Restive Collective

Restive Collective is a Singapore-based agency that uses personal branding for lead generation. We work with founder-led, service-based businesses — coaches, consultants, gym owners and other experts — and turn their real stories into short-form video and carousel content that brings in qualified leads, not just views.



Our funnels are deliberately simple and proven: short-form video content → Meta ads → lead form or WhatsApp automation / landing page → booked conversation. Every client is spending real money every month, and your job is to make that money work.



Why This Role Is Different

This is not a branding or “boost post” role.



You’ll be working on:

Real lead-generation campaigns for real founders

Ad accounts with live monthly spend, reported and optimised daily

A tight, repeatable funnel where your decisions directly change lead volume and cost per lead

You’ll follow clear SOPs — and you’ll also be trusted to make judgment calls when the numbers call for it.

If you want to become a senior buyer who owns performance end-to-end, this role will stretch you in the right way.



What You’ll Do

Run and optimise conversion-focused Meta campaigns 
 & Instagram) across our client portfolio

Follow the daily media-buying routine: morning — check numbers, queue new ads, log and report; afternoon — optimise, analyse what’s working, recommend next moves

Own campaign health — monitor performance, flag issues early and escalate opportunities to the founder

Set up new client ad accounts (one-time setup per client) and launch new creative batches as they come from our script and video team

Support simple funnel setup where needed — landing page, VSL page and WhatsApp automation (we have a ready framework; no complex builds)

Participate in occasional weekend number-reporting for urgent, higher-spend campaigns (numbers only, with advance heads-up — not full optimisation)

You’ll receive priorities and inputs directly from the founder and account manager — no stakeholder chaos. Our VA handles the admin so you can stay on performance.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For

Writing scripts or designing creatives (we have a scriptwriter, video editor and carousel designer)

Client communication or account management

Redesigning offers or pricing

Juggling 50–100 accounts — we are a high-value, low-volume agency and will add buyers before overloading you

Your focus is campaign performance and health, with clear boundaries and structure.

Who This Role Is For

This role is a good fit if you:

Have hands-on experience running conversion ads (leads or sales) on Meta — not branding or awareness

Think in cost per lead, CPC, CTR and ROAS, and can explain why you scale, pause or kill an ad

Stay calm, analytical and accountable when things move fast

Respect structure but don’t freeze when conditions change

Communicate clearly, report proactively and take ownership seriously

Are ready to commit full-time to one team and grow with it



Who This Role Is NOT For

“Set-and-forget” ad managers who report once a week

Freelancers juggling multiple clients or running their own agency on the side

People who only want to run brand awareness or big-budget branding campaigns

Anyone uncomfortable with responsibility tied to real client spend



How We Work

At Restive Collective, you are judged on results delivered, not hours clocked.

Results-driven \u2014 what matters is your campaigns\u2019 numbers \u2014 cost per lead, lead volume and campaign health \u2014 and how proactively you report and act on them

Systems-led \u2014 clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA so you can focus on your actual craft

Small, focused team \u2014 you work directly with the founder, not through layers of management



Compensation & Growth

SGD 800 – 1,200 / month, depending on experience

Clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA supporting you so you can focus on performance

A growth path to Senior Media Buyer — as we add clients you’ll mentor the next buyer, help build our media-buying SOPs and shape how the agency scales

Exposure to funnels, WhatsApp automation and landing pages — grow beyond ads into full-funnel thinking

If you’re looking for a comfortable, low-pressure role, this isn’t it.

If you’re looking to own performance and grow with a young agency, you’ll thrive here.



How to Apply

Please complete the application form carefully. The questions are designed to understand how you think, not just what tools you’ve used.



👉 Apply here: 
 



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.







Final Note

We’re not looking for button-pushers.

We’re looking for a media buyer who:

Respects structure

Protects campaign performance

Takes ownership seriously

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you

title: Shopify Specialist (Theme & Page Builder)
description:
Dear Applicants,



Shopify Specialist (Theme & Page Builder) – We're Hiring!



Our product team plans every page: the idea, which sections go where, and the copy. You bring it to life on our Shopify store as a clean, polished page that works beautifully on every screen. If you have years of Shopify experience, a sharp eye for detail, and enjoy using AI tools to work faster, this role is for you.



IMPORTANT: We value responsible, self-motivated people who take ownership of their work and can deliver quality work with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

 • Build and update pages on our Shopify store (product, collection, landing and campaign pages) from briefs prepared by our product team

 • Customise our existing theme (sections, blocks and templates) and work with page builder apps such as GemPages, PageFly or Shogun

 • Make every page look polished and on-brand: consistent spacing, alignment, font sizes, colours and image quality

 • Create or adapt simple visuals (banners, section images) using AI tools and our in-house design guidelines, and judge whether the result looks right before using it

 • Use AI coding tools (such as Codex or Claude) to speed up builds, and check and test everything they produce before it goes live

 • Test every page before publishing: mobile layout, loading speed, links, and that it matches the brief

 • Flag layout or usability problems early and suggest simple fixes, for example content that will not work well on a phone

 • Update pages for launches, promotions and seasonal campaigns



You should have:

 • At least 4 years of hands-on Shopify experience building and improving store pages

 • Confidence editing Liquid and CSS within an existing theme (adjusting sections, adding settings, fixing layouts). You will customise our theme, not build themes or apps from scratch

 • Experience with at least one page builder app (GemPages, PageFly, Shogun or similar)

 • Evidence of improving a page's conversion or performance, with the before and after to show for it

 • A strong eye for visual detail: you notice when spacing is off, text is too small, images look stretched or a page feels cluttered

 • Good UI/UX awareness: you know what makes a page easy to use on a phone, and how to fix it when it is not

 • Comfort using AI tools to create visuals and write or edit code, and checking their output carefully



You do not need to be a graphic designer. Visuals can be created with AI tools using our design guidelines. What matters most is your eye for detail and your sense of what makes a page look good and sell well.



Note:

 • Full-time basis, 40 hrs/week

 • Monday to Friday

 • 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

 • Your CV/Resume

 • A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

 • Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

 • Links to 2 to 3 Shopify pages you built or improved (live links preferred), with a short note on what you did for each. If you improved a page's conversion or speed, share the before and after



Applications without the above points will be less considered.



P.S. Please format your replies in point form according to the items asked above, e.g.:

 My resume is here:

 Video introduction here:

 I am currently doing... / I am leaving because...

 Here are links to Shopify pages I have built or improved...



The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.





Best regards,

 Loo Yi

description:

We are a young and dynamic growing E-commerce company, looking for someone who is experienced, organized, reliable, and in it for the long run. Our working hour is from Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm GMT+8.



Job Overview:

We are seeking an Influencer Marketing Specialist to identify, engage, and build relationships with influencers who align with our brand. You will manage influencer outreach, oversee campaign deliverables, and track performance to drive impactful collaborations. The ideal candidate has 1–2 years of experience and a strong understanding of influencer marketing.

Requirements:

• Organisational Skills: Ability to manage multiple influencer campaigns simultaneously while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met

• Social Media Knowledge: Familiarity with major social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) and an understanding of their audiences and content styles

• Analytical Mindset: Experience in tracking campaign performance metrics, analysing influencer, and reporting insights to the team

• Creativity: A keen eye for content quality and creativity to identify influencers who align with the brand’s tone and aesthetic

title: German-Speaking B2B Telephone Sales Representative – Funeral Industry
description:
HerdenkSamen Europe is looking for a fluent German-speaking B2B telephone sales professional to build relationships with funeral homes and funeral directors in German-speaking markets. We offer a digital remembrance platform and are expanding our partnerships across Europe. You will work directly with our founder in the Netherlands.



This is business-to-business sales. You will contact funeral businesses and professional decision-makers, not grieving families. This industry requires sensitivity, trust, and a calm, respectful approach.



What you will do

- Research and qualify funeral homes and other relevant B2B partners.

- Call owners and decision-makers in German, explain the offering clearly, and discover their needs.

- Book qualified demos or sales meetings and follow up consistently.

- Keep accurate notes, next steps, and outcomes in our CRM.

- Improve your call approach using feedback and measured results.

- Work independently while communicating clearly with the founder.



You should have

- Fluent spoken German suitable for professional telephone sales (C1/C2 or equivalent). Strong written German is also required.

- Proven B2B outbound telephone sales, appointment setting, or closing experience, with concrete examples and results.

- A natural, empathetic speaking style and excellent listening skills.

- Experience speaking with business owners or senior decision-makers.

- Reliable follow-up, CRM discipline, and comfort working remotely.

- Enough English to communicate with our team.

- Availability during German-speaking European business hours.



Experience in funeral services, memorial products, or B2B SaaS is useful, but proven German-language telephone selling matters most. We value quality conversations and genuine fit over call volume or aggressive scripts.



This is a full-time remote role, approximately 40 hours per week, with substantial overlap with 09:00–17:00 Netherlands time. Starting pay: $5 per hour.



How to apply

Start your application with: I SELL IN GERMAN. Then answer briefly:

1. What B2B products or services have you sold by phone in German? To whom?

2. Give one concrete example of a deal or qualified meeting you personally generated, including your role and results.

3. What is your German level, and where have you used German professionally?

4. Write a 3–4 sentence German opening for a first call to a funeral home owner.

5. Share a 60–90 second audio or video introduction in German if you have one.

6. Which CRM and calling tools have you used?

7. Do you accept the $5/hour starting rate, how many hours per week can you work, and when can you start?



Shortlisted candidates will have a brief live German conversation and a practical sales exercise before any hiring decision.

title: Senior Customer Support & AI Operations Lead
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing consumer brand building a next-generation, AI-powered customer service operation, and we are looking for a senior Customer Support & AI Operations Lead who has been there and done it. This is not a role for someone who has only worked around AI tools. We want someone who has built, or played a major role in building, an AI-powered customer service operation.



You will be our customer support lead, working largely independently. You will handle the cases our AI can’t, but your biggest impact will be building out the support function: continuously improving how our AI system responds and performs, creating the processes and SOPs that keep everything running, and turning customer feedback into insights for the wider business. As the company grows, the role will expand into retail customer support and operations.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (40 hours per week, 1-hour unpaid break)

Location: Remote

Timezone: Pacific Standard Time (PST)

Start Date: Within 2 weeks

Compensation: 10 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



Customer Support Leadership

Own the customer support inbox and escalations as the company’s customer support lead

Clear overnight tickets the AI could not resolve at the start of each day

Process returns, refunds, and replacements accurately and promptly

Identify sensitive, complex, or unusual cases and handle or escalate them appropriately

Ensure every customer concern is documented and followed through to resolution

AI Customer Service Ownership

Own the day-to-day performance of our AI customer service agent (Siena AI)

Review AI-handled conversations, identify inaccurate or weak responses, and find the root cause

Build and refine the knowledge base, intent routing, rules, and response guidelines

Test changes in the sandbox before they go live and monitor outcomes afterwards

Run ongoing quality checks on AI responses and d
 when the AI should handle a case and when a person should step in

Escalate technical or system-level issues when additional support is needed

Building the Support Function

Design, document, and maintain SOPs for the full support operation

Improve processes and use automation to reduce manual workload

Track and report key support metrics such as response time, resolution rate, and AI resolution rate

Deliver regular voice-of-customer reporting, turning ticket patterns into product and business insights

Work closely with leadership on day-to-day operations and longer-term support strategy

Growth Scope (Next 3 to 6 Months)

Expand into retail customer support as the company grows its retail presence

Support EDI and order management alongside the operations team as needed



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 5+ years in customer support, customer experience, or support operations, including a lead role or ownership of a support function

AI Customer Service (Required): Proven hands-on experience building, or playing a major role in building, an AI-powered customer service operation, including knowledge base building, intent routing, prompt and response refinement, sandbox testing, and quality checks on AI responses

Help Desk Platforms: Strong experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar; Siena AI experience is a major plus

Process & Reporting: Track record of writing SOPs and reporting on support metrics and customer insights

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; professional, empathetic, and customer-focused

Working Style: Strategic and analytical self-starter who takes ownership from identifying a problem to resolving it, and who can build a support department rather than just respond to tickets

Industry Background: Experience in e-commerce, CPG, or consumer brands is a plus

Additional Exposure: Experience with retail customer support, EDI, order management, or supporting a product launch is a plus

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Content Repurposing Specialist (Retainer-Based)
description:
Job Overview:



We are a fast-growing digital agency based in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, specializing in helping local luxury real estate teams and boutique businesses scale their social media presence. We are looking for a creative, highly reliable, long-term Video Editor to join our team behind the scenes.

Your role is to take raw concept assets (scripts, stock footage, or unedited clips) and turn them into premium, high-retention 9:16 vertical videos.



Core Responsibilities (Job to be Done):



• Video Editing & Pacing: Cut down raw footage into highly engaging 15-to-60-second vertical videos (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts). Trim out awkward pauses, dead air, and filler words.

• Dynamic Subtitles: Generate and style clean, kinetic on-screen captions. Text must be perfectly synced with the pacing and feature high-end, premium fonts that align with a luxury brand identity.

• Visual Enhancements: Apply clean transitions, color correction, and intentional zoom cuts/punches to maintain viewer attention every 2 to 3 seconds.

• Audio Design: Source and layer trending, royalty-free background music and subtle sound effects (risers, swooshes, clicks) to maximize impact.

• Caption & Queue Management: Write a short, optimized caption for each video and schedule the finalized assets inside our social media pipeline (Metricool/Publer).



Compensation & Work Structure:



• This is a retainer-based, part-time position that scales with your output.

• We pay a flat retainer of $250 to $350 USD per month, per client account you manage.

• Each client account requires a consistent delivery of 12 to 15 completed vertical videos per month.

• As we sign more clients, you will be handed more accounts to manage, allowing your monthly income to scale proportionally (e.g., 4 accounts = $1,000 to $1,400/mo).



Application Instructions (Mandatory Test Edit):



To be considered for this position, you must complete a quick 15-second test edit using the exact real estate script provided below. You are free to use any high-definition, royalty-free luxury home tour footage, stock clips, and background music you choose.

The Test Script:

• Hook Text (0–3s): "Inside a $3,500,000 Modern Mansion in Southlake, Texas..."

• Body Text (3–12s): "Featuring a private chef's kitchen, custom floor-to-ceiling glass windows, and a resort-style infinity pool."

• Call to Action (12–15s): "Looking to move to DFW? Click the link in our bio to view the private listing."

Applications submitted without a link to a completed 15-second video matching this exact script will be automatically ignored.
